articleTitle: Use of Blockchain Technology in Electronic Voting Systems: An Overview from Computer Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Block chain is a new and growing technology in the IT world right now. This technology is a way to store data that is not based in one place. It gives centralized data storage systems an alternative that is safer from a security point of view. This paper gives an idea of how Block-chain Technology can be used to protect an e-voting system. In this paper, we looked at all the work that has been done in the same area before. We chose a number of research papers in the same field and looked at them. From what we can tell from these papers, using Block-chain Technology for voting will be very useful. And this system for voting online will be much safer than the one we have now. Electronic voting, or E-voting, is simply the use of computers to cast and count votes. This method makes the voting process faster and cheaper. When more technology is used in a certain area, security problems also get worse. When you vote online, security is important. By using the Block chain and its distributed database system, we can make it harder for people with bad intentions to change the database. This makes the e- voting system more secure.

Author Keywords: Ethereum are all words that describe these things

articleTitle: Real-Time Collaborative Gaming using Multiagent Brain-Computer Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In this research explores the convergence of real- time collaborative gaming and multiagent brain-computer in- terfaces (BCIs), aiming to revolutionize interactive gaming ex- periences. The study investigates the feasibility and potential of employing BCIs to facilitate seamless and synchronized gameplay among multiple participants. The contemporary gaming landscape demands heightened immersion and interactivity. Traditional control interfaces often constrain the user experience. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a novel approach that leverages multiagent BCIs to enhance real-time collaborative gaming engagement. A controlled experiment was conducted involving participants equipped with BCIs, interconnected to a gaming platform. Brain signals were recorded and analyzed to develop a multiagent framework for collaborative gameplay. The system allowed participants to influence game dynamics and communicate in real time through neural commands. The results demonstrate the successful integration of multiagent BCIs in collaborative gaming scenarios. Participants exhibited improved synchronization, leading to enhanced team coordination and gameplay immersion. This research paper aims to bridge the gap between real-time collaborative gaming and neural interfaces by introducing a multiagent BCI paradigm. By fostering enriched interaction and synchronized gameplay, this study contributes to the ongoing evolution of immersive gaming experiences, paving the way for future innovations at the intersection of gaming and neurotechnology.

articleTitle: Ensemble Machine Learning based Weather Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The technique of predicting the weather using science and technology for a particular area is known as weather forecasting, we employed the ensemble approach to produce more precise results. Ensemble learning enhances machine learning outcomes by mixing numerous models. The predictive performance of this strategy is superior to that of a single model. Many machine learning methods and algorithms can anticipate changes in the weather. According to prior studies, there are many additional weather forecasting methods. Depending on various factors like temperature, wind, humidity, and rainfall.

articleTitle: Optimizing Emotion Recognition Through Weighted Averaging in Deep Learning Ensembles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Facial emotion recognition (FER) is a necessary in order to bridge the communication gap between people and computers since, in the complete range of face-to-face contact, facial expressions are a sort of communication that convey the majority of a person's emotional and mental state. This field's innovations also enhance how successfully computers interact with or assist people. The vast body of research in this field is focused on Deep Learning. FER has drawn interest from the research community due to its possible applications. The main objective of FER is to relate different facial expressions to the associated emotional states. Even though profile pictures from different angles are essential for a functional FER system, most current systems only take frontal photos into account, which is a severe drawback. By adapting a pre-trained DCNN model's dense top layer(s) to be FER-compatible, the model is employed. The model is then fine-tuned using emotion data, which eventually increased the FER accuracy to a larger degree. In this study, We have used ensemble method over VGG16 & VGG19. The suggested method is tested using the well-known datasets FER2013 and CKPLUS and two different DCNN models that have been pretrained (VGG16 and VGG19). The suggested technique had an accuracy of 90.38% on FER2013 and 96.53% on CKPLUS after ensemble learning.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Sentiment Fusion Network for Social Media Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Recent advancements in various social media platforms allow fusion of different sentiments on various online platforms. Thus, multimedia aspects contribute the common set of sentiment transfer, sharing opinions and other sentiment resources over various online channels. The sentiment fusion offers online users a sentiment access through a various unified interfaces. Since Sentiment Transfer Mode (STM) support sentiment transfer through various text and data files therefore, STM has been chosen for the use in the Sentiment Fusion Networks (S-FSN). This paper proposed a Quantitative Sentiment model for sentiment transfer which includes text, and visuals data collected from various online channels. This model can help to analyse single sentiment detection over single-multimedia (SD/1/1) heavy network. The waiting time for sentiment detection for the selected parameters in each channel is derived explicitly. This study also formulated equations to describe the fusion function responsible for generating sentiment within the multimedia system, as well as the delay associated with detecting sentiment for the specific parameters examined in the research.

articleTitle: Developing a Robotic Solar-Powered Fire Detection and Avoidance System With Machine Learning-Based Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This research addresses the challenge of ensuring a consistent energy supply for forest fire surveillance systems, which is critical in the field of Computer Science, AI, ML, Data Mining, NLP, Computer Vision, and Robotics. Traditional solar-powered solutions rely on fixed-mounted rooftop panels, which are often inadequate due to their limited electricity production capacity, especially under variable weather conditions. This study introduces an innovative, all-weather, autonomous solar tracking system that adapts to the changing position of the sun throughout the seasons, ensuring optimal energy collection for the surveillance equipment. To properly navigate the sun motion, the cautioned gadget merges sun's trajectory monitoring modalities with pv sensing. It begins via determining the season with a sensor that measures the volume of sunshine. The sun function detector & a customized PV itinerary algorithms then estimate the solar's course. The gadget makes use of specific tracking algorithms for sunny, gloomy, and moist instances, using artificial intelligence algorithms to forecast versions in the weather & adjust the panels as it should be. The approach has been proved in simulated experiments to be able to mitigating the influence of versions in the climate at the same time as keeping a steady and specific alignment facing the sun in all climates. The technique will increase the ability of photovoltaic cells utilized for wooded area fire tracking to produce electricity, improving the dependability and effectiveness of such vital device. This precise use of AI and gadget getting to know in environmental surveillance represents a step towards stronger and longer-lasting fire caution systems, which might be important for woodland preservation and management.

articleTitle: Evaluating Docker Container Security through Penetration Testing: A Smart Computer Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The widespread adoption of containerization, exemplified by Docker, has transformed software deployment, enabling agile applications. However, its popularity invites malicious exploits, heightening security incidents in containerized environments. This paper details a comprehensive penetration testing approach for Docker container security, spotlighting file system vulnerabilities and artifacts. Using penetration testing methodologies, the study systematically scrutinizes Docker container file systems. Detection of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) and Common Exploit Weaknesses (CEWs) within the file system identifies potential attacker entry points. The paper also delves into artifact extraction from the file system, encompassing logs, configurations, and command traces. These artifacts unveil the container's activities, shedding light on potential intrusion vectors. Examination of container metadata and configurations uncovers misconfigurations and potential attack surfaces. By Exploration of file system vulnerabilities and artifacts equips security practitioners with crucial insights for bolstering Docker container defense.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Super-Resolution with Convolutional Neural Network Ensembles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The goal of image super-resolution (SR) is to increase the resolution and quality of low-resolution images, and it is a crucial problem in computer vision. Recent years have seen incredible progress in SR problems using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). However, boosting SR performance even further remains difficult. Using the strength of Convolutional Neural Network ensembles, this research introduces a new method for image super-resolution. By pooling the advantages of several different CNN models, we may produce an ensemble that is more accurate and robust than any of the individual models. Here, we present a flexible ensemble framework for integrating multiple SR designs into a single system for comprehensive problem-solving. We show that our ensemble approach improves image super-resolution outcomes through a thorough experimental assessment on industry-standard benchmark datasets. We also explore other methods for training and fusing the ensemble members, such as consensus-based methods and adaptive weighting schemes. To achieve optimal SR performance, these methods aim to collect synergistic data from multiple independently operating networks. Our ensemble-based method not only achieves state-of-the-art super-resolution results, but it also shows resistance to noise and other degradation factors. To further illuminate the process of image super-resolution, we also offer some information on the interpretability of ensemble decisions. this research offers a fresh and efficient approach to improving image super-resolution using ensembles of Convolutional Neural Networks. Our method not only improves the current state of the art in SR, but it also points to a promising way for making super-resolution methods more robust and reliable in real-world settings.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Diagnosis and Detection of Liver Cancer: An Approach Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: One of the most important organs in our body is the liver, yet liver cancer incidence has been sharply rising in recent years, primarily as a result of poor lifestyles. In order to accurately identify the ailment, this study suggests a diagnosis system based on multiple machine-learning techniques. After managing the dataset's missing values, data encoding, and segregation are carried out for pre-processing. Upon conducting feature scaling on the used dataset, machine learning models are applied. Out of the seven models utilized, the findings demonstrate that SVM and LGB classifiers perform exceptionally well in terms of the highest accuracy and least amount of loss, while the Random Forest approach surpassed all others when recall, F1 score, and precision are to be considered.

articleTitle: UNet Segmentation based Effective Skin Lesion Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Skin cancer is a common and possibly fatal condition. Effective therapy depends on early discovery and precise diagnosis. This study proposes a two-step, segmentation-and classification-based method for skin lesion analysis. The U-Net architecture, a semantic segmentation model based on deep learning, is used in the initial stage to segment skin lesions. On the test set, the suggested method achieves a promising segmentation accuracy of 94.88%. Precise segmentation helps separate the skin lesions from the surrounding environment and facilitates further classification. Using a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier, the segmented lesions are classified into benign and melanoma categories in the second stage. The classification results show a 78% accuracy rate, indicating that the suggested method has the capacity to differentiate between benign and malignant skin lesions.

articleTitle: Detection of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Using VGG-16 and Inception-V3
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a major health concern amongst a majority of women. Many issues, including infertility, acne, hirsutism, irregular menstrual cycles, and obesity, may result from it. It could also result in type 2 diabetes, endometrial cancer, heart problems, and high blood pressure. Early diagnosis of PCOS may help prevent and treat such health concerns. This paper proposes using ultrasound imaging of the follicles to extract vital details about the ovary, such as the kind of cyst, the variety of follicles present, and how the size of the follicle reacts to hormonal imbalance. Using image processing techniques, morphological operations, and machine learning, the models identify the valuable characteristics in the ultrasound pictures, highlight them, and then build a suitable classification model for the same. On using transfer learning models such as VGG-16 and Inception-V3, an accuracy of 100% each is obtained.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Ensemble Method for Plant Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Crop-borne illnesses are more resistant and frequent. Thus, producers face a problem that impacts net productivity. If plant illnesses could be detected early and warned to farmers, this problem may be solved. Convolutional Neural network, logistic regression, and Stochastic gradient descent classify picture databases and segment best. We used the CNN (NLRSGD-Ensemble) approach to extract deep image attributes by customising the LR, SGD, and CNN. This research uses the Basic plant village Dataset. The proposed method yields 97.7% accuracy in experiments.

articleTitle: Load Profiling Approach in Clustering Automated Electrical Power Metering System using Hybrid Computer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Analyzing energy usage patterns is critical for efficient resource management and has long helped automated electricity monitoring systems. Collaborative methods have aided load profiling precision, though their benefit relies on data quality. This paper introduces a load profiling approach using teamwork techniques suited for automated electricity tracking. The suggested strategy combines unsupervised and supervised group efforts to boost load profiling accuracy. Results show the proposed model enhances profiling exactness, with a mean absolute percentage error of 5.32%. The proposed approach can be utilized in different settings, including private and business structures.

articleTitle: Battery & Fuel Cells Comparative Study On Application With Iot Gadgets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The majority of the Web of Things (IoT) gadgets are fueled by electricity lines. Consequently, major grid disruptions, that can happen with catastrophic events, stop the flow of electricity to such equipment. The majority of widely employed utilities were assessed in order to promote the creation of Internet of Things gadgets which can function under calamities. The operating duration, power generation, and overall technical characteristics of battery packs with lithium ion plus fuel-cell devices were contrasted in this investigation. Due to the disappointment, the biofuel cells with 10W had a lower running period over the remaining units at 57 minutes. Additionally, a Rasp Pi-based internet of things gadget was assessed to find the best power method. Although capacitors are now more affordable, biofuel cells' greater energy productivity will become more beneficial when their price decreases.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Machine Learning Algorithms for Deep Fake Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Deepfake is a newly developed area of artificial intelligence technology that is widely used on social media and involves superimposing the facial features of one person over that of another. Machine learning is the primary component of deepfake creation, and it has made it possible for deepfake videos and pictures to be produced much more quickly and cheaply. Although the term "deepfakes" has a bad reputation, the technology is increasingly being used both professionally and personally. Although while it is still pretty new, recent technical developments make it harder and harder to distinguish between deep fakes and synthetic pictures. This study presents a comparative analysis of different algorithms, such as KNN, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest tree, Decision or Classification tree, and Naïve Bayes algorithm. To evaluate the effectiveness of these algorithms, the dataset undergoes preprocessing before being used as input for each algorithm. Subsequently, their performance is measured by calculating and comparing metrics like F1-score, recall, precision, and accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Applications and the use of Big Data to Manage the Operation of SMEs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Managing big data is a trending concept for industrial development. Machine learning helps to increase the sales rate of the firm improving the quality of the production process in the SMEs. Training and skill development managed by technological tools and big data analytics ensure the progress of the firm providing information security. Big data help to design the operations of the firm analyzing the market condition and customer demand. Furthermore, the data safety issues create barriers to the technological advancement of the firm, and the managers need to update and monitor the software development to increase consumer confidentiality in SMEs.

articleTitle: Clustering-Based Energy Efficient Routing for Flying Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Forest fires pose a serious risk to the stability of the ecological system. Due to the effective usage of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in a variety of military and rescue applications, flying ad-hoc networks (FANETs) have offered a wide field for research and deployment. UAVs are extremely mobile in a three-dimensional (3D) environment and have limited battery power, which leads to several issues such as short travel distances and unreliable routing. These issues can be helped by the energy-efficient routing. In this research work, we have proposed an improved Sparrow Search algorithm-based clustering and energy-efficient routing scheme (SSA-CEER) for energy-efficient FANETs by adhering to network resource constraints. A method for selecting the Cluster Head (CH) is proposed, employing a weighted sum-based function. The chosen parameters for this selection process include the residual energy of UAVs, their distance to the Base Station (BS), relative mobility, and degree difference. The next forwarder-hop route is chosen using as link lifetime and the future direction of one-hop neighbors, which ensures reliable data transfer to the BS. The routing strategy at the core of this approach is position-based greedy routing. The proposed method is examined using the network simulator NS-3.25. The results of our experiments demonstrate notable improvements in terms of packet delivery, delay, and routing overhead.

articleTitle: Analyse Indications of Vital Parameters in Patients Using Business Intelligence and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In 21st century human beings deals with a variety of diseases as a result of their lifestyle choices and the surroundings environment. Taking precautionary measures for health is essential for human well-being, and accurate prediction of diseases is a challenging task not only for doctors as field medical science continues to experience significant growth each year. Advancements of technology within the medical sector can greatly benefit human lives. Data analysis plays a vital role in handling large amounts of healthcare data efficiently. These proposed model is an AI-based disease diagnosis system that determines diseases based on symptoms. The system is developed using business intelligence, allowing for efficient graphical visualization. Supervised learning is applied to the data to classify predicted values and proposed researched model in this paper achieve accuracy in disease prediction, leading to improved diagnostic capabilities for helping medical practitioners.

articleTitle: Direction-Aware Greedy Routing Protocol with Recovery Mechanism (DAGR-R) For Flying Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: FANET (Flying Ad Hoc Network) is formed using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) that are used in a variety of areas like emergency communications, surveillance, and monitoring. FANETs communication nodes have a higher level of speed, which results in intermittent connectivity. A swarm of UAVs, commonly referred to as a FANET. Real-time communication between UAVs is required. Drones can maneuver well in three-dimensional spaces, but they have weak batteries that can lead to issues like limited usage time and inefficient routing. Due to the intrinsic network features and environmental factors, routing data in FANETs is challenging, hence a routing mechanism that considers all these factors into account is essential. This paper considers the choosing of the forwarder UAV, and avoiding the looping of messages that impact the performance of a FANET because UAVs have quick movements and frequent topological modifications. For effective communication, this paper proposed a Direction-aware greedy Routing with a Recovery mechanism (DAGR-R). The suggested approach considers the network's ability to adapt on its own in the event of topological changes. The simulation outcome demonstrates that the suggested protocol outperforms other routing protocols in terms of delay, packet delivery, and routing overhead (RO).

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches to Neuroimaging Data for Early Alzheimer's Disease Detection with Emphasis on Convolutional Neural Networks' Superior Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: For effective treatment and better results, it is essential to detect Alzheimer's disease (AD) at its earliest stages. Understanding the anatomical and functional changes in the brain associated with AD has become increasingly dependent on neuroimaging data. This work includes a systematic review of previous research on the use of Machine Learning (ML) methods on neuroimaging data for the diagnosis of AD in its earliest stages. We thoroughly compared and contrasted deep learning architectures with more conventional ML methods. In our approach, we first preprocessed the neuroimaging data to improve feature extraction, and then we trained the models on a carefully selected dataset that included data from people with AD and those without the disease. According to the findings, deep learning models, in particular CNNs, performed better than conventional ML methods, successfully differentiating early-stage AD from normal ageing with an accuracy of 94.7%. This research highlights the importance of ML in changing the way AD is diagnosed, providing hope for improved clinical decision-making and earlier intervention.

articleTitle: IoT and Camera Vision Implemented Smart Bins
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The issue of Smart Bin is an evolving problem in the developing nations, as evidenced by India's ongoing struggle with unsightly roads and inadequate trash management. This study introduces a flexible waste collection system that addresses two key elements: the Internet of Things (IoT) and strategically positioned street cameras. Internet of Things (IoT) sensors, developed with machine learning algorithms can analyze the amount of waste present both inside and outside of bins, allowing for the creation of increased efficient collection routes. At the same time, street cameras offer real-time visual information to support the findings of sensors. These cameras offer live visual data, which not only confirms the results of the IoT sensors but also helps investigates particular problems like illegal dumping and obstacles that could impede waste collection activities. Bin levels are constantly monitored by sensors, which transmit data for centralized tracking. Waste assembly is validated by cameras. Our research calls for an integrated strategy to trash management in developing nations, which has the potential to significantly improve the cleanliness of streets, minimize environmental harm, and enhance public health. This integrated system holds the potential to significantly enhance waste management procedures through the use of sensors that provide continuous monitoring and data transmission for centralized tracking, as well as cameras that validate garbage assembly. The possible advantages include cleaner streets, a less environmental impact, and improved public health, providing a comprehensive solution to the growing problem of smart bin shortage that many nations face due to inadequate waste management systems.

articleTitle: Detecting Insider Threats in Cybersecurity Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The subject of cybersecurity is evolving at a rapid pace, and one of the challenges that organisations face is keeping up with the ever-evolving nature of the threat posed by their own employees. These risks, which come from contractors or staff inside the organisation, usually get by the normal security measures. This is due to the fact that these individuals are trusted folks. This research presents a comprehensive approach to the identification of insider hazards by making use of both machine learning and deep learning methodologies. We propose a hybrid model that combines deep neural networks, which are able to capture fine-grained behavioural subtleties, with featureengineered patterns that are indicative of anomalous insider behaviours. This model would be used to identify anomalous insider behaviours. Our model had a detection accuracy of 96.3%, which was higher than the existing state-of-the-art approaches, and it surpassed them by using a dataset that was created from user activity records and system logs from multiple different companies. In addition, the deep learning component made it feasible to identify minute patterns of potentially dangerous behaviour that had previously escaped detection. When traditional machine learning techniques are coupled with deep learning methods, as shown by our findings, it may be possible to develop insider threat detection technologies that are more effective, dependable, and versatile within the area of cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Classifiers used in Speech Processing: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Speech is the most convenient way for people to express their emotions. It follows that this communication medium should be extended to computer programmes. This fresh research makes use of advancements in all domains of computers and technology, necessitating an update on the present approaches and techniques that enable Speech processing. Numerous strategies have been used in the literature of analysis of speech and classification techniques. Deep Learning approaches have been presented as a substitute to standard Speech processing techniques. Deep Learning approaches are discussed in this paper and covers recent research in which these techniques are used for speech-based identification.

articleTitle: Leveraging Temporal Patterns with LSTMs Networks for Financial Forecasting: A New Stastical Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The intricate temporal patterns observed in financial markets might have an impact on market outlook and trading decisions. The challenge of effectively predicting these markets remains difficult due to the limitations inherent in conventional linear forecasting methods. The aim of this study is to assess the efficacy of Long Short-Terms Memory (LSTMS) networks, which are advanced recurrent neural network designs, in accurately forecasting financial time-series data. This evaluation will entail a comparison of the performance between LSTMS networks and classical models. The present study employs data derived from the S&P 500 index spanning a twenty-year timeframe for the purpose of analysis. The information comprises not just the daily closing prices but also incorporates trading volume and a range of technical indicators, including moving averages, relative strength index (RSI), and momentum. The information provided is extensive and serves as the foundation for the development and evaluation of the forecasting models. A sequence-to-sequence Long Short-Terms Memory (LSTMS) model was devised with the explicit objective of capturing the inherent temporal dynamics inherent in financial data. The research employed a rolling window approach, wherein a predetermined sequence of daily data was employed to predict the closing price of the subsequent day. The LSTMS architecture is composed of input layers, multiple LSTMS units, and output layers, with the incorporation of dropout layers in between to mitigate the problem of overfitting. In order to develop a benchmark, a comparison was conducted between the LSTMS approach and traditional models such as ARIMA and a basic RNN structure.

articleTitle: F-CFDT: A Hybrid Cluster Formation and Data Transmission Protocol in WSN using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Efficient Routing Methods for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) majorly focuses on power conservation. Clustering is employed to prolong the operational lifespan of WSNs. A single node, acting as the cluster head (CH), serves as the representative for other nodes during communication. The paper proposed a novel hybrid routing technique based on fuzzy logic for cluster formation and data transmission to the Base Station (BS). The approach of creating clusters based on the energy levels of nodes results in the formation of optimal clusters. The simulation results shown the effectiveness of the proposed protocol in network performance. The proposed protocol enhances the network's longevity, stability, and average energy consumption.

articleTitle: CLERC: An Intelligent Sign Language Translator for Improved Accessibility using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Clerc's system is a modern smart language interpreter using advanced methods like artificial intelligence, imagery recognition, and natural languages translation. The Clergs System includes these are just some of tools used. The system is able to do this by turning gestures in sign language into verbal and written outputs smoothly thus helping people with hearing impairment to communicate easily in real time. In this research, an object recognition SSD MobileNets and FDN feature extraction models are used for accurate gesture detection. A machine-learning model can also be used to predict accurate translations. The efficacy of the Clerc system has been tested and validated to the utmost extent in different settings such as public places, schools, hospitals amongst others. This research seeks to explore possibilities of improving the system's precision, efficacy, scalability, and use with regards to the practical application.

Author Keywords: SSD Mobile Net Object recognition model

articleTitle: Cognitive Computing for Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Understanding Medical Imaging Narratives
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In recent years, the intersection of cognitive computing and natural language processing (NLP) has emerged as a pivotal area of research, promising transformative advancements in medical imaging. This paper delves into the integration of cognitive computing techniques with NLP to enhance the interpretation and understanding of complex medical narratives. We introduce a novel framework that leverages the cognitive capabilities of machines to process, analyze, and comprehend vast amounts of unstructured medical text. Our approach employs deep learning architectures and semantic analysis to extract clinically relevant information from radiology reports, patient histories, and other textual data sources. Preliminary results indicate a significant improvement in the accuracy and efficiency of medical image annotations, leading to more precise diagnostic insights. Furthermore, the system demonstrates an adeptness at understanding intricate medical jargons, abbreviations, and context-dependent interpretations. This research not only underscores the potential of cognitive computing in revolutionizing medical imaging but also sets a precedent for its application in other domains requiring nuanced language understanding.

articleTitle: A Smart Model to Manage Traffic Using Infrared Sensors and Bell Detection System: A Computer Controlled Traffic System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The escalating challenge of traffic congestion in urban areas necessitates innovative solutions at the intersection of computer science and artificial intelligence. The main problem is in the outdated nature of conventional traffic signal systems, which function based on predetermined time intervals and fail to appropriately adjust to the ever-changing patterns of urban traffic. This study presents a sophisticated traffic management system that utilizes machine learning and data mining concepts to optimize real-time traffic signal regulation. The suggested system utilizes infrared sensors to constantly monitor the level of traffic congestion at crossings. The data is transmitted to an advanced microcontroller, which utilizes machine learning techniques to forecast traffic patterns and subsequently modify the timing of traffic signals. This approach enables a more seamless and adaptable control of traffic flows, resulting in a substantial decrease in congestion and enhancement of overall traffic efficiency compared to traditional systems. By incorporating computer vision techniques, the system's ability to detect and evaluate several traffic parameters, such as vehicle count, speed, and categorization, is improved. The data is essential for the machine learning models to make well-informed recommendations regarding the durations of traffic lights. Furthermore, the system integrates robotics components to physically manipulate and operate traffic light hardware, guaranteeing smooth functioning and immediate response to the computational decisions made by the microcontroller. This research not only addresses the immediate practical concerns of urban traffic management but also contributes to the broader field of AI and robotics in realworld applications. The synergy of data mining, machine learning, and computer vision within a robust traffic management system exemplifies the transformative potential of AI technologies in urban infrastructure management.

articleTitle: Realtime Atrial Fibrillation Detection System For IoMT Using Hybrid Machine Learning Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a type of cardiac arrhythmia in which the atria contract rapidly and irregularly, resulting in an irregular heartbeat. AF can lead to decreased blood flow to the body, blood clots, stroke, heart failure, and other cardiovascular complications. This paper proposes a detection system that would provide real-time AF detection by capitalizing on the power of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks and XGBoost classification models for the IoMT (Internet of Medical Things), which refers to medical devices and applications with Internet connectivity. This paper aims to improve patient outcomes, reduce healthcare costs, and increase access to healthcare services through the proposed detection system.

articleTitle: Scalable Machine Learning: Development of Efficient Clustering Algorithms for High-Volume Temporal Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the era of big data, the analysis of large-scale time series data has gained significant importance across various applications such as finance and healthcare. However, traditional clustering approaches, often encounter accuracy and scalability issues when applied to extensive data sets. This paper introduces innovative clustering method specifically tailored for time series data to enter these challenges. These methods leverage advanced data structures for computational efficiency, optimal distance measurements to improve, improve accuracy, and parallel computing framework for enhanced Scalability. Rig testing involving millions of time series occurrences from real world. Data sets was conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed methods. The results indicate that these novel clustering algorithms can deliver high-quality outcomes even when handling massive data sets. The exhibit verity in accommodating different time series lengths and resilience in handling noise. These characteristics contribute to effective and scalable time series clustering, entering the proposed approaches suitable for real-time analytics in data intensive environments. Consequently, this research facilitates the extraction of actionable insights in real time, offering valuable contributions for both academia and industry practitioners. Additionally, it broadens the spectrum of tools available for the analysis and interpretation of large-scale time series data.

articleTitle: Application of WEKA Machine Learning Tools in Phytoremediation for the Removal of Heavy Metals in Water Treatment Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In this study, we leverage the interdisciplinary strengths of Computer Science, AI, ML, and Data Mining to address the pressing environmental issue of river pollution, with a focus on the Yamuna River's deteriorating conditions. Recognizing the critical impact of heavy metal contamination in aquatic ecosystems, our research utilizes an AI-enhanced phytoremediation strategy for the efficient reduction of both physicochemical properties and hazardous heavy metals from the river water. We perform a thorough examination of different physicochemical factors including pH, electrical conductivity, total dissolved solids, dissolved oxygen (DO), biological oxygen demand (BOD), chemical oxygen demand (COD), and the levels of metals such as lead (Pb), zinc (Zn), and nickel (Ni). To process and interpret the complex dataset, we apply sophisticated Data Mining techniques using the software WEKA, which enables us to extract meaningful patterns and insights from the environmental data. Our approach adopts a green technology method, phytoremediation, enhanced by AI algorithms to optimize the removal process, targeting the reduction of contaminants in a cost-effective and scalable manner. The integration of AI and Data Mining in environmental management signifies a transformative step towards more intelligent, efficient, and sustainable practices. The implications of this research are manifold, extending beyond environmental science to inform developments in AI-driven ecological modeling and ML-powered monitoring systems. The outcomes of this study not only shed light on the current state of the Yamuna River but also demonstrate the potential of AI and Data Mining as powerful tools in the fight against environmental pollution

articleTitle: Integrating Big Data Analytics and Machine Learning for Predictive Maintenance within Industrial IoT Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: With the proliferation of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) devices, there is an unprecedented growth in the volume, velocity, and variety of data generated from diverse sources. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the application of big data analytics for predictive maintenance in IIoT systems. By leveraging advanced machine learning and data analytics techniques, we propose a novel framework, Hybrid-sense that anticipates potential failures and optimizes maintenance schedules, thereby reducing downtime and operational costs. Our approach integrates multi-modal data sources, including sensor readings, operational logs, and environmental factors, to create a holistic predictive model. We employ a hybrid architecture combining both traditional statistical methods and deep learning algorithms to enhance prediction accuracy. The results, validated on real-world industrial datasets, demonstrate a significant improvement in early fault detection and maintenance prediction over existing methodologies. This research not only paves the way for more resilient and efficient IIoT systems but also offers insights into the intricate interplay between big data and industrial operations, emphasizing the transformative potential of datadriven decision-making in the manufacturing sector.

articleTitle: Unmasking Depression via Attention-modulated Text Analysis using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: A higher risk of suicide is associated with depression's rising prevalence. It is difficult to distinguish between depression and evaluate sentiment in written submissions. Only using deep learning models causes a lack of robustness and effectiveness of the systems. The incorporation of Attention-enabled deep learning architectures would provide superior performance compared to deep learning architectures. We utilized a novel Attention-enabled deep learning paradigm to develop five non-attention-based deep learning models and five Attention-enabled deep learning models. We validate our models for reliability and benchmark against existing state-of-the-art models. There is a mean increase of 1.52% in accuracy for Attention-enabled deep learning models over their solo counterparts on the Reddit dataset, as well as a 1.21% increase for the Kagle dataset. The best-performing model (DistilBERT-BiLSTM) showcased an Accuracy of 94.93% with an AUC score of 0.9501. Also, Attention-enabled deep learning models proved to be more stable and reliable. The system was subjected to the formation of ROC curves and three statistical tests that demonstrated the system's robustness in predicting depression. As a result, we confirmed the validity of all our models, confirming the hypothesis that the Attention mechanism proves to be a powerful and versatile approach for detecting depression in various cross-domain scenarios.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Music Genre Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: A convolutional intermittent neural network (CRNN) for labeling music is presented in this paper. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are used by CRNNs to extract nearby elements, while recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are used to briefly summarize the extracted highlights. We compare two CNN structures and CRNN that have been applied to music labeling, controlling the number of parameters presented and the preparation time for each test. Overall, our research revealed that CRNNs perform well in terms of parameter quantity and preparation time, proving the usefulness of their crossbreed structure for highlight extraction and highlight summarization in music.

articleTitle: Enhancing Pedestrian Traffic Analysis with Fuzzy Clustering and WEKA Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In this paper, we address the burgeoning field of Computer Vision and AI with an innovative approach to automated human behaviour detection, a critical component in the development of intelligent systems. Our research focuses on distinguishing human actions in dynamic settings, a task that has gained importance due to the extensive visual data captured by Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) systems. We introduce a sophisticated model for recognizing human activities by analyzing trajectory data extracted from video sequences within the CAVIAR dataset. The core of our proposed model is a threetiered process encompassing feature extraction, behaviour learning, and trajectory segmentation. Initially, the model employs fuzzy logic to partition the trajectory, aligning with the dynamic motion characteristics present in the dataset. Subsequently, it extracts temporal and spatial features critical for understanding human movements. To evaluate our model's performance, we simulate four distinct pedestrian behaviors and utilize the RepTree algorithm—a decision tree method known for its efficiency and accuracy in handling complex data. The model's efficacy is demonstrated through its ability to capture instantaneous features and to discern variations across different regions, resulting in high accuracy in activity detection. This work not only contributes to advancements in the domains of ML and data mining by refining feature extraction methods but also enhances the interpretation capabilities of AI systems for realworld surveillance and security applications. Our findings offer promising insights into the development of more autonomous and context-aware surveillance systems, bridging the gap between static observational data and dynamic behavioural analysis.

articleTitle: WoS Bibliometric-Based Review on IoT in Healthcare Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The healthcare industry has experienced a significant digital revolution in recent years. The way doctors and hospitals provide care for their patients is changing as a result of digital technologies like IoT devices and monitors. This is a good development that is assisting in streamlining healthcare, reducing expenses and enhancing access to vital medical information. The pharmaceutical production process can be optimized with the use of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, and it enables healthcare professionals to access patient data quickly and effectively. articleTitle: The Importance of Virtual Reality in the Modern and Technical Era in Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the modern era of technology virtual reality plays a significant role in interaction with individuals. Virtual reality creates a more excellent range of empathy and helps to connect with the majority. This helps to increase engagement in a creative way as it enhances creativity. VR is used to show creativity to people where it is needed to attract people. The emergence of technology in the developing era induces productivity faster whereas virtual reality presents things in real by understanding the surroundings. Virtual reality improves communication skills which help in the marketing area and makes it easier to make great deals.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Transmission Reliability in Cluttered Environments using Adaptive Wireless Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Wireless data transmission in complicated terrains like cities or deep woodlands sometimes raises dependability concerns. These issues are caused by barriers, multipath fading, and signal interference. Our study uses adaptive wireless sensors to improve data transmission reliability to solve this problem. These sensors are meant to dynamically modify gearbox parameters in real time, unlike standard sensors. This distinguishes them. The study uses key research methods. Dynamic Path Selection chooses the best transmission paths for data packets. Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC) alters modulation and coding rates based on real-time environmental information. The study also uses Spatial Diversity using Beamforming. This method concentrates energy using multi-antenna systems, increasing signal intensity and decreasing interference. Practical experiments in clutter-filled regions showed improved gearbox reliability. Compared to standard systems, adaptive sensors reduced packet loss by 45% and increased throughput by 30%. Adaptive wireless sensors increase connection reliability in difficult conditions. These sensors may be utilised for many applications, including urban IoT frameworks and autonomous navigation.

articleTitle: A Survey on Cloud Computing Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Today, cloud computing research is widely utilised in both industry and academia. Cloud computing (CC) benefits both users and cloud service providers (CSPs). The security challenges that come up with CC have been well examined in the literature. This paper's evaluation of the literature on cloud computing security, risks, and problems have that as its goal. The data security of CC is examined in this article. It is a study of security concerns related to cloud data and related subjects. As is well known, network security needs to be upheld for data because cloud computing is a new industry. CC is used by many enterprises to store enormous volumes of data in the cloud. Data protection is crucial since it might be in the form of audio, text, video, etc. Many different strategies have been developed by researchers to safeguard data in the cloud. The article discusses in detail the protection strategies and tactics which are used globally to give the best data protection by minimising threats and risks

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis and Machine Learning for Efficient Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The increased use of digital technology in business and industry has contributed significantly to the recent fast expansion of the supply chain ecosystem. It would be an understatement to claim that machine learning is not central to this shift. The way businesses operate has been profoundly altered as a result of the advent of these new modes of communication, the automation of formerly manual operations, the increased significance of digital records, etc. In an era of decreasing profit margins and more discriminating clients, supply chain management is becoming increasingly vital as businesses attempt to differentiate themselves. Management and optimization of the Supply Chain at all levels based on data. Decision-making in the supply chain may benefit from machine learning approaches in a data-rich setting. These days, no business can afford to ignore Machine Learning technology since they are everywhere. In highly competitive marketplaces, this fact stands out like a sore thumb. In this research, we investigate the feasibility of implementing machine learning strategies into existing supply chain management systems. To better use the huge amounts of data presently being created by the supply chain, the primary goal of this study is to ascertain whether or not machine learning methods can be incorporated into the existing toolbox accessible to supply chain decision-makers.

articleTitle: IoT Attack Detection and Prevention Through Machine Learning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Attacks on web applications are constantly growing in both frequency and severity. Abundant data on the internet stimulates hackers to attempt different types of cyberattacks. Attack detection using conventional approaches and outdated data processing techniques has become outmoded as a result of this development. The purpose of this study is to investigate IoT attacks and discuss the efficient ML technique implementation strategies for restricting security risks. Among different security techniques, Machine learning (ML) systems demonstrated commendable feasibility in improving network and device security for the Internet of Things. The study with contextual research recognises and comprehends that modified “Support Vector Machine (SVM)” as well as “Random Forest (RF)” ML techniques showed optimal performance in IoT attack detection and prevention.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for Real-Time Traffic Management in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: With the advent of smart urban spaces, efficient and flexible traffic management has become a necessity. The changing nature of urban traffic makes traditional traffic management systems—which rely on pre-established systems—inefficient. This study presents a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) model for real-time traffic management in smart cities. To optimize traffic flow and reduce congestion, the model uses deep-rooted reinforcement learning to automatically adapt to changing traffic conditions Urbanized several simulated systems representing a range of vehicle scenarios were used to evaluate our technology. According to the results, the traffic volume increased significantly and the typical waiting time decreased compared to the traditional traffic management system. The program can also successfully accommodate unexpected traffic incidents such as accidents or roadblocks. This study demonstrates the potential of DRL to transform urban traffic management and create a more sustainable, efficient and effective smart city.

articleTitle: An Optimized Ensemble Machine Learning Model for Predicting the Age of Abalone
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Abalones are endangered marine shells that can be found off the coastlines. It is a tremendous cause of iron and pantothenic acid which is a beneficial diet reserve and farmingall over the world. By estimating the age of abalones, researchers may better understand the ecosystem and conserve this species. For predicting the same, Machine learning uses a range of techniques to quickly and precisely develop mathematical models and make accurate predictions based on previous data. In this paper, an optimized ensembled model is proposed that predicts the age of abalone from physical measurements. Ensembling is done using SMOreg and random forest machine learning models. SMOreg provides us with an accuracy of 84.5% while random forest gives an accuracy of 84.74%. While comparing and validating the performance of the proposed model with the traditional model, accuracy has increased to 90.44%.

articleTitle: Real Time Investigation of IoT based Sun Follower: A Computer Assisted System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The goal of this investigation is to explain the conceptualization, production, & evaluation of just one axis internet-connected sunlight surveillance systems. The detection model comprises of a number of sensors controlled by an Atari platform, as well as the language of things web page to display outcomes. In the present investigation, solar panels having a thirty WP capability were employed. On the fifth level for the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Electronics at Universidad Negeri Se Padang, Indonesia the inspection procedure was conducted. Screening results' gathering of information occurs in immediate as well as will be shown as graphical data, Sensors that are attached to a computer and a WIFI device provide the data. Additionally, the information is transferred through a Thingspeak technology computer which might be seen on a laptop or an Android-powered gadget. In sunny skies, photovoltaic cells can provide power throughout 7:00 morning until 18:30 pm; however, in cloudy or wet conditions, power output drops & separates early, before nightfall. According to the experiment accomplishments, every record can be transferred correctly and promptly watched online. As a result, the tracking solar panel is successfully and quietly watched, while Google makes it simple to retrieve every record.

articleTitle: Utilizing Dynamic QR Codes to Enhance Secure Payment Transactions: An Approach to Secure Computer based Transactions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Quick Response code model plays an important role in mobile security and payments market. All QR code looks similar but technology behind these makes it unique. For the transactions security there always has been a concern in information security. So, to handle this a new system is introduced which is achieved by cryptographic QR code algorithm which is dynamic and makes it even more secure and its unique ability makes it even more secure. Dynamic QR codes have emerged as a pivotal technology in the realm of payments, revolutionizing the way transactions are conducted. Proposed model and working architecture of the system shows that system has achieved the desired output. The performance of system hardware has more efficiency than traditional algorithms and compared it to some other algorithm the processing time is less and execution speed is fast which makes it even more secure and reliable. As the technology evolves and matures, it is poised to further transform the way we conduct financial transactions, paving the way for a more secure, efficient, and inclusive payment ecosystem.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Classification of Application Layer DDoS Attacks using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Increased internet use has connected organizations to a shared network. These networks are vulnerable to many security threats and are victims of attackers. DDoS (Distributed Daniel of Service) attack exhausts network resources. These attacks target the network layer, transport layer and application layer. Though, it leaves the huge impact on resources at different levels. Especially in the application layer, DDoS attacks make the network inaccessible to legitimate users. It is crucial to detect application layer DDoS attack in network. Feature extraction is found helpful in getting high accuracy of detection through machine learning classifiers in this case. In this study, we have implemented efficient machine learning classifiers to detect application layer DDoS attacks using SDN dataset features. We have used Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), and Independent Component Analysis (ICA) to reduce the feature set of data. In addition to, machine learning classifiers are trained with extracted features and prediction of application layer DDoS attack is done. It is observed that LDA model extracted 1 feature out of 13 and gives maximum accuracy of detection for used classifiers. The result analysis of this study with Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Support Vector classifiers is achieved up to 99.6% and the proposed work is compared to previous studies to analyze the results.

articleTitle: Protecting Data from DDOS Attack in a Cloud Based Intrusion Detection System Security through Enhanced RSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Since cloud computing platforms have become an essential component in a range of different industries, it is still challenging to ensure that user data and system resources will remain secure inside these settings. This paper proposes a methodology to identify and mitigate unwanted traffic and packets, specifically duplicate packets, in cloud computing envi- ronments. The procedure requires the creation of an IntrusionFinder and Detector (IF-AD) system that allots secondary storage and keeps user information in a secure manner. This technique does a comparison between the sizes of downloaded files and the sizes of the original files, searching for any variations between the two that would suggest a probable distributed denial of service assault (DDoS). The RSA cryptography procedure is employed in order to further strengthen the degree of security that is provided by any future file transfers that may take place. The problem that has been identified and a potential solution for has been proposed with the intention of enhancing the safety of cloud-based systems by identifying and preventing unauthorised access to files as well as modifications to them.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Load Forecasting (ELF) in Smart Grids Using Neuro-Fuzzy Models: A Focus on Accuracy and Decision Process Transparency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the domain of smart grid technologies, the capacity to forecast energy loads with high precision is crucial for the optimization of grid management and the promotion of sustainable energy practices. Traditional models for Energy Load Forecasting (ELF) often fail to fully comprehend the non-linear dependencies and unpredictable nature of energy consumption within these advanced systems. Addressing this gap, the current research introduces an innovative Neuro-Fuzzy approach, designed to enhance ELF within smart grid frameworks. This approach harnesses the predictive power of neural networks, renowned for their proficiency in learning from historical data, and combines it with the versatile reasoning capabilities of fuzzy logic systems, which excel in managing uncertainty and imprecision. By integrating these two computational paradigms, the proposed model exhibits a remarkable ability to navigate the complex and erratic patterns of energy usage, learning adaptively and accounting for the unpredictable variables that affect load demands. Empirical assessments conducted on datasets derived from actual smart grid implementations reveal the superior performance of the Neuro-Fuzzy model over contemporary forecasting methods. It not only delivers enhanced accuracy but also brings robustness to ELF. The model's intrinsic interpretability also plays a pivotal role in decision-making processes, allowing grid operators to transform intricate data analyses into practical, executable strategies.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Based Approaches for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder is a neurodevelopment state manifest through difficulties with community interaction, constrained repetitive activity patterns and, the presence of specific interests or occupations. ASD is mainly caused by genetics or by environmental factors; however, its condition can be improved by treating and detecting ASD at its earlier stages. There are many ways to detect ASD, including psychological exams and neuro imaging modalities. Fuzzy logic is working in many sophisticated applications of artificial intelligence, including natural language processing. Fuzzy logic simulates human decision-making, but much more quickly. The main and the foremost objective of this paper is to represent an overview and provide the in-detail briefing of fuzzy logic methodology and concepts for detection of ASD. This paper discusses a systematic and literature review through a variety of scholarly and academic research papers, professional expert discussions and online databases. The goal of this study is to examine Fuzzy logic based expert systems for ASD identification.

articleTitle: Mediation of Marketing Intermediaries and AI Adoption Between Livestock Products Marketing and Economic Status of Pastoralist in Ethiopia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Motive of present multivariate analysis is to access the moderation of marketing intermediaries and Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption as mediator in between livestock products marketing and economic status pastoralist. Meta Analysis was employed by the researchers for literature systematic review and Forest plot and funnel plot were used for Meta-Analysis. The theoretical review identified three theories namely Marketing Expansion theory, Porters Value Chain theory and modernization theory used as intermediary between livestock product marketing and pastoral economy. AMOS was used to find mediation of AI and Meta essential was used to manifest the moderation of marketing intermediaries. The livestock product marketing in the domestic niche is moderately low due to be deficient in of shoppers and inferior value. Pastoralists have ethical to supply livestock product on the marketplace; but market behave inelastic. Therefore, it needs strong and formal marketing intermediary/channels.

articleTitle: Integrating Web 3.0 Technologies for Advanced Information Retrieval Systems in the Educational Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The exponential growth of web documents has resulted in traditional search engines producing results with high recall but low precision when queried by users. In the contemporary internet landscape, resources are made available via hyperlinks which may or may not meet the expectations of the user. To mitigate this issue and enhance the level of pertinence, it is imperative to examine the challenges associated with querying the semantic web and progress towards the advancement of semantic search engines. These search engines generate outcomes by prioritizing the semantic significance of the context over the structural composition of the content. This paper outlines a proposed architecture for a semantic search engine that utilizes the concept of semantics to refine web search results. The resulting output would consist of ontologically based and contextually relevant outcomes pertaining to the user's query.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Fake news is a big concern since it spreads widely over social media and other media channels, creating significant social and national damage with devastating consequences. In order to address this issue, substantial research how to be recognized on fake news detection has been done. The purpose of this study is to analyze the existing research on fake news detection and select the best conventional machine learning frameworks to develop an algorithm for supervised machine learning. The algorithm will be able to classify false reports as true or fraudulent using textual analysis methods such as NLP. The proposed process involves data preprocessing and vectorization, where the NLP library will be used to perform tokenization and feature extraction of text data, utilizing tools such as Count Vectorizer and Tiff Vectorizer. Further, feature selection methods will be employed to evaluate and determine the most fitting features to achieve the highest precision based on confusion matrix results. The outcome of the decision tree classifier algorithm gives the accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: Audio Feedback Segregator using Sentiment Analysis: Role of Computer in Music
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Audio feedback segregation using sentiment analysis separates audio feedback based on the outlook articulated within the audio indication. Attitude investigation is an appliance information procedure that analyzes text or speech's exciting tendency. This approach can be used to segregate audio feedback based on whether it is optimistic, pessimistic, or impartial. The segregation process can help identify feedback valuable to businesses and organizations for improving the products or services. The sentiment analysis technique involves training a machine learning model on a dataset of labeled audio feedback to predict the sentiment of new audio feedback. The model can then automatically segregate feedback and store in one database based on the predicted sentiment.

articleTitle: An IoT-based Heavy Vehicle Parking and Accident Avoidence System for Smart Cities using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Due to so many vehicles on cities, there had chaos for the parking space which had become a headache. To solve this problem this paper “Smart Heavy vehicle Parking System” is created as a better way to make the needing of people a bit easy. The paper will purely be based on java and is developed as an android-based application which will make this paper easily usable for everyone. It had unique features like booking a slot one-day before parking and heavy vehicle location with the help of google having a login-based security function, an automatic plate detection system, etc. With the simple implementation of this app will book the available slots for vehicle parking at their convenience. It consists of minimal cost for everyone as it is smart. It will book a slot for any sort of vehicle with several hours you have to book for the vehicle. You can track your vehicle location with the help of google maps by using IOT devices. There is provided a manual guideline for using the app which will make a convenience for its user. It is a purely user-based application which had a backend server used to store the data of its user. We also provided a support contact system for any query and emergency, provided by the admin details. The main purpose of this paper is to create a systematic type of parking system.

articleTitle: Research on Traditional Art Image Reconstruction Method Based on Computer Vision Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the framework of the digital era, the technology of image processing is one of the technologies that is being used increasingly often in all aspects of modern life. Image correction may be handled using algorithms based on computer vision, which can increase the correction's influence on the image as a whole. The conventional method of identifying structural systems collects data via the use of wired or wireless measuring systems. The process of establishing sensors and the equipment used for data collection is laborious and takes a lot of time. The process has two stages: the first is the extraction of the line drawing, and the second is the rendering of the line drawing. An edge detection approach that integrates low-level and middle-level visual information is used to extract the line drawing in the process of on-line drawing extraction. This method is used to extract the drawing. The edges are then simplified and linked in accordance with the computer vision theory. Additionally, the image processing technology is used as the research object in order to develop a scientific model for the distorted image. These steps are based on the findings of traditional edge detection. Image restoration can be helped along by filtering samples of the image and getting rid of any noise that is there. The fundamentals of computer vision and the technologies that are connected to it are broken down in detail, and the behavioral patterns of visual interaction are investigated. The image of Chinese traditional art serves both the role of art communication and as a medium and symbol for cultural communication. At the same time, it carries on the legacy of a fine traditional culture that has been passed down from generation to generation in China. The image processing technology that is based on computer vision algorithms provides a bigger number of benefits, in addition to a better degree of accuracy.

articleTitle: Protecting A Nuclear Power Plant Against A Stuxnet Attack: Power Of Computer Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the modern world, cyber-attacks have become a major concern for critical infrastructures such as nuclear power plants. The Stuxnet attack of 2010 demonstrated the potential for a cyber-attack to cause physical damage to a nuclear power plant, making the protection of these facilities against such threats a critical priority. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the measures that can be taken to prevent a Stuxnet-like attack on a nuclear power plant. The review covers both technical and non-technical measures such as network segmentation, software patching and updating, and the implementation of effective security policies and procedures. It is important to implement a multi-layered defence system that addresses the technical, operational and organizational aspects of security, and the need for continued vigilance and improvement in the face of evolving cyber threats.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in Computer-Generated Imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In order to estimate the model using the method it is necessary to train two different models simultaneously. The first model, called the model (D) is responsible, for determining whether a particular sample is from the training data or generated by another model called G. On the hand G aims to understand the underlying distribution of the data. By training G to maximize the likelihood of D making mistakes a competitive environment is established. There are applications for G and D but one particularly notable solution emerges. D consistently evaluates any input as if it came from training data while G effectively captures the details of that training data distribution. Notably this system can be trained using known techniques like backpropagation when implementing G and D as multilayer perceptrons. This eliminates the need for inference networks or intricate Markov chains, during both training and sample generation processes. Thorough evaluations of the generated samples confirm the potential of this framework as demonstrated through testing. This innovative approach offers an efficient means to capture data distributions, which could potentially revolutionize generative modeling.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System for Smart Vehicles Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: As Electric Vehicles (EV s) become more prevalent, the need to protect their complicated and associated systems from cyber threats which vital necessity. It is critical to ensure the safety of an electric vehicle to prevent damage to human life or assets. Controller Area Network (CAN) is a message-broadcast protocol i.e., work on data link layer most deployed on EV s to facilitate communication between different control components called Electronic Control Units or ECUs. An ECU controls the functioning of different electronic or mechanical components and communicates with other ECUs on the network by sending messages over CAN bus.
