Communication over CAN is unencrypted and unauthenticated and thus prone to malicious attacks. This work presents an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) for electric vehicles. It uses different machine learning algorithms designed specifically for EV s to identify adversary attacks. Thus, through this work, we aim to strengthen the security of an EV by detecting and mitigating potential intrusions or attacks. The proposed system keeps check on network traffic, communication protocols and helps in exchanging data between various parts of the EV such as ECU s, also with charging stations and other attached devices. Key components of the IDS include a data collection mechanism, feature extraction, machine learning algorithms, and a decision making module. The data collection mechanism gathers relevant information from different sensors, control units, and communication channels. We employ feature extraction techniques to transform collected data into meaningful features for analysis. We further compare and contrast the different machine learning techniques to provide useful insights into their functioning.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Ambiguity Detection in Social Media Context
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), understanding the nuances of pragmatic ambiguities, where words or phrases can have multiple meanings based on context, remains a challenge. Beyond traditional NLP tasks, detecting pragmatic ambiguities can enhance human-robot interactions, improve virtual assistants, and aid in interpreting complex documents like legal contracts. This presents the application of artificial Intelligence (AI) or machine learning to detect such ambiguities. This paper introduces a novel framework for the detection of pragmatic ambiguities, particularly focusing on sarcasm, irony, and contextual ambiguity. Employing pre-processed data, the framework utilizes a BERT model and a Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) network for the respective tasks. These models operate in a multi-task learning environment, which serves to enhance both learning efficiency and predictive accuracy. Comparative analysis with existing methods such as SVM and LSTM reveals the superior performance of our proposed framework, achieving an accuracy rate of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$98.00{{\% }}$</tex>. The findings validate the efficacy of our approach, suggesting its applicability in the development of more robust natural language processing systems.

articleTitle: Implementing TANAGRA for the Visualization and Analytical Interpretation of E-commerce Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The multidisciplinary study of data mining is crucial to artificial intelligence and computer science because it allows researchers to glean useful insights from massive data sets; these datasets are essential to online shopping platforms. This field investigates the ways in which data mining. Consumer impression analysis, a rich source of qualitative data reflecting customer attitude, is the center of this study. Researchers use sophisticated natural language processing algorithms to sift through customer reviews in search of patterns and key opinion leaders. In order to provide complex insights on customer behavior, this study dives into the world of sentiment analysis and goes beyond just gathering comments. Unstructured textual data may be dynamically analyzed using ML approaches in conjunction with NLP. This method can automatically decipher intricate client data. These methods, when put together, allow for the extraction of valuable information that are critical for the development of business strategies and the improvement of digital marketplace customer interaction models. An all-inclusive data mining technique known as TANAGRA is used in the investigation. It handles problems caused by the scale and variety of big e-commerce datasets via analysis. This study's findings provide insight into the nuances of consumer behavior and point the way toward better user experience and e-commerce strategy optimization. To better understand how customers, behave on e-commerce sites, the research employs Data Mining, ML, and NLP. As a result, Computer Vision is able to analyze more complex data patterns, and AI predictive analytics get fresh understanding.

articleTitle: Utilization of Random Forest Classifier (RFC) To Predict the Quality of Beverages
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In contemporary times, individuals strive to attain a lifestyle characterized by opulence and extravagance. Individuals often utilize these items either for ostentation or for their routine activities. Currently, the ingestion of fizzy beverages is widely prevalent among the general population. This study pertains to the prediction of beverage quality through the analysis of its diverse attributes. The dataset utilized in this study was obtained from publicly available sources, including Kaggle. The Random Forest algorithm was employed as a technique for analysis. Various performance measures are calculated and then compared across the training and testing sets to predict the overall quality of the beverage.

articleTitle: Employing Tensor Decomposition and Contextual Inference for Reducing the Semantic Discrepancy in Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Despite the growing need for effective image tagging in both commercial and research domains, the inconsistency between image content and text annotations remains a significant issue. We propose an innovative approach that leverages deep learning and tensor decomposition to enhance the quality of image labelling and eliminate the reliance on labor-intensive manual tagging. Our methodology transforms images into tensors, facilitating the formation of a standardized feature space. We employ a sophisticated five-layer neural network architecture that integrates three-level tensor decomposition to match images with their context groups accurately. This structure is adept at capturing the nuanced patterns in data, which is crucial for reducing the semantic discrepancy between visual and textual information. We have rigorously evaluated our algorithm using the Corel-10K dataset, focusing on the specific case of penguin images, to demonstrate the efficacy of our model. The results showcase a marked improvement in the relevance of generated tags, thereby enhancing the retrieval accuracy and mitigating the issue of inappropriate tag assignment. This work not only contributes to the fields of Machine Learning and Data Mining by refining feature extraction and context estimation techniques but also has significant implications for the development of NLP algorithms that can better interpret and generate descriptive tags for visual content. Moreover, our approach sets the stage for future explorations into the integration of AI-driven image tagging systems with robotic systems for autonomous data handling and organization.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using AI for High Frequency Traders
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The objective of the research is to develop a prediction algorithm for stock price analysis, specifically targeting the Indian stock market's NIFTY and BANKNIFTY derivative markets, including futures and options. The main objective is to establish a relationship between the dependent factor, stock price, and independent factors such as opening price, closing price, high and low values of stock, and volume of stocks bought. The need for this research emerged from the significant impact of stock market decisions on financial gain for investors. With a high percentage of retail traders in the Indian trade market experiencing losses in recent times, there is a demand for effective prediction techniques to assist investors in making informed decisions. This study differentiates itself from existing literature by focusing specifically on the Indian trade and incorporating deep learning algorithms. In this approch, the solution utilizes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in conjunction with a Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) neural network-based model to analyze various quantitative strategies in stock markets. The CNN is employed for stock selection, automatically extracting features from quantitative data, followed by an LSTM to preserve time-series features, enhancing profit margins. This combined CNN-LSTM model is used for stock price prediction. we will be using stock technical indicator (STI's) and derive a final prediction with the help weighted average ensemble model. The expected outcome of this research is to provide retail traders with a valuable tool for making informed decisions in the Indian stock market. The performance measures of the developed models, such as accuracy values, will be used to evaluate and compare the effectiveness of different deep learning architectures. Theeventual outcome of this paper will contribute to the field of stock market prediction and assist investors in achieving financial gain by adopting AI-based prediction techniques.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Lithium-ion Batteries in Electric Vehicle Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The accurate prediction of the Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of lithium-ion batteries is crucial for the effective management and maintenance of electric vehicle (EV) battery systems. RUL prediction involves estimating the number of cycles or time until a battery's capacity degrades to a specified threshold, considering factors such as temperature, charging/discharging profiles, State-of-Charge(Q1), Voltage (C1, C2), and operational conditions. The RUL prediction of lithiumion batteries in EV battery management systems is a challenging task due to the complex interplay of degradation mechanisms and evolving battery technologies. Data-driven approaches, leveraging machine learning algorithms and advanced data analytics techniques, have emerged as the primary method for RUL prediction. However, challenges remain in ensuring the scalability, reliability, and real -time applicability of prediction models. This paper aims to contribute to the field by developing state-of-the-art RUL prediction models that seamlessly integrate into existing EV battery management systems. This article first summarizes and classifies various methods for predicting the remaining service life of lithium-ion batteries that have been proposed in recent years. On this basis, by selecting specific criteria to evaluate and compare the accuracy of different models, find the most suitable method. Finally, summarize the development of various methods. According to the research in this article, the average accuracy of Random Forest regression and classification models is higher than the accuracy of the other methods, and the prediction cycle is shorter than the average of the other methods.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study about Content-Based Image Retrieval using Features from Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: "Content-Based Image Retrieval (CBIR)" is a popular approach that is frequently used to handle the image retrieval problem. Despite the fact that the CBIR approach has seen tremendous improvements, the fundamental challenge of finding and retrieving pertinent photos with high levels of accuracy remains. A lot of demand exists for the creation of efficient CBIR systems that utilise modern techniques. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) were used, which led to a substantial paradigm shift in machine learning and outstanding performance. This study's major objective is to ascertain whether deep CNN models can be employed to boost picture retrieval effectiveness. In a range of image-processing tasks, such as object identification, classification, and clustering, among others, CNNs excel very well. This work proposed the CBIR methodology, which implements the extraction of features by using a range of pre-trained CNN models. For this experimental research project, radiology and meteorological datasets were used. The findings demonstrated that pre-trained deep CNN models' learnt features may be quickly applied to image retrieval tasks and outperform hand-crafted features utilized in conventional CBIR techniques in terms of performance. A CBIR framework using features from a "pre-trained deep CNN model (VGG16)" was provided in accordance with the study's findings. Put the recently created CBIR algorithm through its paces using a "multi-class dataset" made up of images connected to the weather. The innovative CBIR technique resulted in an average retrieval precision of 86.73%. The standard CBIR design, which relies on manually created features (such color, texture, and form attribute), has produced an average retrieval precision of 73.25% in comparison to this. The unique methodology outperformed the traditional method, which showed a 13.48% larger gain in average precision.

articleTitle: Analysis of Visual Expression of Light and Color in Movies based on Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Movies are in the era of “black, white and gray” ruling the screen, people have a strong desire for movies to truly reproduce colors, because the main rhythm of the “black, white and gray” film visual music is not clear enough, the momentum is not strong enough, the meaning is not rich enough, and the color is not enough. Visual aesthetics cannot be attractive… Aiming at the dual challenges of colorization quality and timing stability in film colorization, a generative adversarial network with a recurrent structure is proposed, which can be used for automatic colorization of films without any reference frames and artificial intervention. The network generates a confrontation network based on classical conditions: the generator is used to generate color images and complete the task of colorization; The discriminator is used to identify the authenticity and improve the performance of the generator. Cycle structure and timing consistency loss are introduced to integrate timing information and solve the stability problem of coloring. Experimental results show that this method can effectively reduce flicker in the generated movie sequence while ensuring the coloring of a single frame image. This paper studies and analyzes the visual expression of light and color in movies based on wavelet neural network.

articleTitle: Improved Skin Cancer Detection Using Efficient NetB7 Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Early identification may help prevent or cure skin cancer, a serious worldwide health problem. To increase the accuracy and effectiveness of skin cancer prediction, this research employs machine learning approaches. The HAM10000 dataset was used to train and test our brand-new skin cancer prediction model, which is based on the state-of-the-art EfficientNetB7 architecture. To resolve class imbalance concerns that are prevalent in dermatological datasets, data augmentation procedures are employed to give equitable representation in the training data. The RGB attributes that were taken from the photographs and incorporated into our model. Our approach outperforms conventional machine learning models with an accuracy of 89%, which is promising. In addition to improving skin cancer prediction algorithms, this research provides a fast and affordable option to aid in early detection. Our research demonstrates the value of accurate skin cancer detection in improving patient outcomes and reducing healthcare expenditures, as well as the potential of machine learning in dermatological diagnostics. This research not only paves the way for future developments in the area of automated skin cancer diagnosis but also offers hope for wider applications in the area of medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Watershed Management and Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: As we move towards development, sustainability is kept in mind with each plan and action. Land and water are a crucial part of human life and source of various ingredients required in social, economic and cultural growth. Their conservation and preservation are the aim of watershed management. The different approaches for watershed management provide us with small scale as well as large scale solution to sustainably develop and manage land and water resource. This manuscript also discusses about the challenges in the path of sustainable use and development of water and land.

articleTitle: Behavior Analysis Using User's Search History Through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This study gathers information on users' search queries and website visits over six months to examine trends in users' search behavior. Web analytics software is used in the study to monitor 1000 participants' search queries and website visits. Natural language processing and machine learning techniques are used in data analysis to find user search behavior trends over time. The study's findings will provide valuable information about how users interact with online content, allowing website designers and search engine optimization experts to create more user-friendly websites and boost their visibility in search engine results. Moreover, internet advertising can be more precisely targeted, leading to more effective and successful marketing campaigns, by analyzing trends in consumers' search activity.

articleTitle: Disease Detection in Crop's using Transfer Learning: An analysis on Detection through Computer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Current Era is of interdisciplinary techniques where technological growth in one sector helps to resolve the problem's faced in other sectors. Here we discuss the diseases that occur in crops that affect the production of crop per hectare. But it could be resolved by using machines and deep learning techniques that detect them in early stages and hereby increases the production of crop. In latter part of the paper, we discuss about the transfer learning and its benefits for other crops.

articleTitle: Real Time Virtual Mouse System Using Hand Tracking Module Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Humans have a lot of expertise using their fingers to perform activities and manipulate items. Users may choose and move data with their hands instead of a mouse. In this study, we will use a brand-new technique for replacing current mouse technology using a live camera to control mouse movement virtually. Two typical methods include increasing the number of buttons or moving the tracking ball on the mouse. Instead, we advise redesigning the hardware. To virtualize mouse tasks, we propose using a camera and computer vision technologies, and we show how it can do all the functions offered by current mouse devices. The creation of a mouse control system is demonstrated in this project. The system proposed in this project, which represents the future of human-computer interaction (HCI), may cause some gadgets to become latent. Our research focuses on employing hand gestures to operate the cursor pointer without the use of any connected or wireless electronics. The mouse's functionalities, including left and right clicks, cursor movement, and scroll up and down, will be handled and processed utilizing a variety of hand gestures. Our system is capable of carrying out tasks that a physical computer mouse can carry out thanks to computer vision technology, which uses a camera to take command of the system via mouse activities. By changing real-time images from the streaming video, the system will take control of the user with the aid of their hand movements. The frames will be analyzed for movement tracing and pattern detection.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cognitive Radio Networks using AI-Driven Stackelberg Game Strategies for Proactive Susceptibility Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the rapidly advancing field of wireless communications, the concept of Cognitive Radio Network Systems (CRNS) has been enriched by the emergence of a new paradigm known as Collective CRNS Channels. This approach, stemming from the development of Federated Dialogue and Device-to-Device (D2D) systems, posits that entities can serve as collaboration beacons, thereby securing temporal and spatial rights for spectrum sensing. Contemporary research predominantly focuses on the spectrum market dynamics, delving into aspects such as spectrum leasing and trading within economic frameworks. However, these investigations have typically presupposed passive roles for relay nodes, neglecting the scenario where active intermediary nodes may opt out of collaboration with primary users due to the incentives presented by a spectrum market. This study adopts a novel approach, employing a Dynamic Stochastic General Game (DSGG) model to scrutinize the interplay between secondary users' inclinations for bandwidth leasing versus collaborative engagement. This model facilitates a deeper understanding of the strategic behaviors of users under the influence of market forces and the allocation of spectrum rights. The findings of this research underscore the necessity of integrating economic considerations into the architecture of future radio spectrum auctions. It is demonstrated that the economic behaviors of secondary users, governed by a preference for spectrum leasing, introduce complex variables that must be accounted for in the design of collaborative CRNS channels. This study paves the way for more nuanced and economically informed models in the arena of spectrum allocation and management, a critical component in the landscape of computer science, AI, ML, data mining, and wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Classification using Deep learning based Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Plant diseases lower crop quality and quantity, making them crucial. Thus, early disease identification and diagnosis are essential. To automate Maize leaf disease classification, we propose a deep learning-based approach. Convolutional Neural networks identify picture databases and perform best in image classification. We customized the Logistics Regression and applied the Convolutional Neural Network(hybrid) method to extract deep image characteristics. This research uses the maize leaves dataset from the Plant Village and PlantDoc datasets. The proposed method yields 93.2% accuracy in experiments.

articleTitle: Developing an Ontology-Driven Automated Healthcare Framework with SWRL for Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel AI-driven ontologybased framework for disease diagnosis and prediction, leveraging the advancements in machine learning and data mining. We have constructed a comprehensive ontology that maps the complex relationships between a multitude of diseases and their manifested symptoms. Utilizing Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL), we have engineered a set of robust rules that facilitate the intelligent prediction of diseases, embodying the principles of NLP for enhanced interpretability. The developed system operates in two fundamental stages. Initially, we define a sophisticated class hierarchy within our ontology, detailing the intricate object and data properties with precision—a process that showcases our application of computer vision techniques to interpret and categorize medical imagery. The second stage focuses on the application of AI-powered rules, which are executed to systematically extract and present detailed disease information, including symptomatology, adhering to established medical protocols. The efficacy of our ontology is validated through extensive evaluations, demonstrating its capability to not only accurately diagnose but also predict diseases, with a particular emphasis on the AI methodologies employed. Furthermore, the system calculates a final risk score for the user, derived from a meticulous analysis of the results. This score is a testament to the seamless integration of AI and ML in developing a user-centric diagnostic tool, promising a significant impact on future research in AI, ML, NLP, and robotics within the medical domain.

articleTitle: Advanced Techniques in Network Traffic Analysis: Utilizing Wireshark For In-Depth Live Data Packet Inspection And Information Capture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The escalating frequency and sophistication of cyber-attacks have placed a spotlight on the importance of Quality of Service (QoS) and robust network security mechanisms. Effective traffic analysis and distribution are critical for maintaining the integrity of network applications and safeguarding data. Our research focuses on the development and assessment of a network intrusion detection system (NIDS) that utilizes the advanced packet analysis capabilities of Wireshark, a renowned network protocol analyzer. The system is designed to enhance network security by enabling more efficient and accurate data collection through network monitoring tools. This serves as the foundation for detecting and thwarting a wide range of malicious activities, including malware and spyware incursions, within network traffic. The innovation of our approach lies in its integration of packet sniffing technology with AI-driven analysis techniques. By applying Machine Learning algorithms to the data captured by Wireshark, our NIDS is capable of identifying patterns indicative of intrusive behavior, which might elude traditional detection methods. We present a comprehensive evaluation of our system, showcasing its efficacy in real-time intrusion detection and its potential for integration into existing network infrastructures. This study contributes to the ongoing discourse in cybersecurity, offering a sophisticated tool in the battle against digital threats and reinforcing the role of intelligent systems in protecting network environments

articleTitle: Leveraging Model Distillation as a Defense Against Adversarial Attacks Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Adversarial attacks on deep learning models threaten machine learning system security and reliability. The above attacks use modest data alterations to produce erroneous model results while being undetected by humans. This work suggests model distillation to prevent adversarial perturbations. The student model is taught to emulate the teacher model in model distillation. This is done using teacher model soft outputs. Our idea is that this strategy organically strengthens the student model against adversarial assaults by keeping the teacher model's essential knowledge and generalization capabilities while reducing weaknesses. Distilled models are more resilient to adversarial assaults than non-distilled models, according to experiments. These models also perform similarly on undamaged, uncorrupted data. The results show that model distillation may be a powerful defense against machine learning adversaries. This method protects model resilience and performance.

articleTitle: Big Data: A Strategic Tool for Enlightening Business Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Traditional companies are undergoing an ever-increasing digital transformation, which, as a result of the widespread impact of digital technology, is leading to a fundamental reorganization of whole markets. The significance of using big data analytics (BDA) to generate competitive advantages for enterprises is well acknowledged; nevertheless, there is still a lack of consensus regarding the role that BDA plays in the process of strategic decision-making inside organizations. The primary objective of this investigation is to carry out a study of big data as a strategic instrument for illuminating business decision-making. A qualitative research study was used for this investigation. The primary data for this investigation were generated through the use of a case study that evaluated Zara and Netflix. According to the findings, analytics performed on large amounts of data have a significant impact on practitioners. The operational strategic decision-making processes at Zara and Netflix now include data analysts as an intrinsic part of the process, and discussions are driven by data and rigour rather than by gut and intuition. BDA has led to a more performance-oriented use of strategic tools, which has enabled both Zara and Netflix to make strategic decisions in real time. This not only boosts agility but also reduces the risk of making the wrong judgments, which is a double win.

articleTitle: An IoT Based Mood Evaluation Device for Pets: Power of Computer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In this highly advancing era, where everyone is dependent for everything on machines, a tool must be there that can help the human beings to take care of beloved pets. To do so, it is necessary to know about how they feel at some specific time period and its cause. The design that is proposed here contains mainly two aspects, i.e., one using a sensor-based arrangement and the other will be the observed abnormalities through gathered knowledge from their behaviour. Basically, a sound sensing design will sense the bark of the canines and the sensed voice will be monitored and judged with the ideal sounds of the barks already saved in the system in large amount. The system will match the bark through the cross-correlation function applied and give results accordingly. The other aspect acquires the deep study into pets like what they would react according to certain situation. All these factors together will help create a scenario for owner to understand and decide whether their pet is feeling fine or not and act accordingly.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Prediction of Energy Density for Additively Manufactured AlSi10Mg Samples by Laser Powder Bed Fusion Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) process has recently become popular due to its ability to manufacture complex shapes with high precision. Among the various alloys for LPBF, AlSi10Mg stands out differently due to its lightweight nature, corrosion resistance, and design flexibility. The two important quality indicators for LPBF manufactured parts are surface roughness and Energy density, which should be within optimal range to ensure high-quality production. This study aims to improve this optimization process through a new approach—using a machine-learning model to predict the requisite laser energy density to manufacture AlSi10Mg. The study utilized machine learning models that were trained using four input parameters: Laser Power (W) Scan Speed (mm/s) Hatch Spacing (microns) and Layer Thickness (microns). Four different machine learning models were employed to predict the required Energy Density: Linear regression, Poisson regression XGBoost and ExtraTrees regression. The Poisson regression model yielded the results with an RMSE value of 11.13 and an R square value of 0.99. The XGBoost gradient boosting model also achieved outcomes with an RMSE of 52.18 and R values of 0.94. Overall, the trained machine learning models proved effective, in predicting the optimal energy density necessary for LPBF thereby enhancing manufacturing process accuracy and quality.

articleTitle: Identification of Drowsiness in Drivers using OpenCV: A Robotic Automated Device
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Unnatural deaths in the modern period are on the rise, although a large portion of them are caused on by the drunken drive and driver fatigue. It is extremely risky and causes car accidents and roadside injuries. The preventive Actions had been taken by using openCV technology i.e. Image Processing. This module is designed to stop avoidable fatalities from drunk driving-related accidents and tiresome of the driver. This module includes Node MCU, alcohol detection (MQ-3),MEMS sensor, web camera, buzzer, vibration motor, high intensity lamp and GSM. Many traffic accidents occur today as a result of drivers' lack of focus and alertness. We refer to this as driver sleepiness. This results in a variety of undesirable circumstances that negatively impact human life. The primary objectives of this study are to identify driver drowsiness and determine the best course of action. There are numerous techniques that depend on how the car is moving or how the driver is acting. One technique is the physiological method, which aids in keeping the driver awake and distracted from sleepiness.

articleTitle: Fog-Based Attack Prediction Model for Internet of Things using Machine and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has fundamentally altered the manner in which we communicate and interact with the digital world. On the other hand, the growing connectedness and complexity of IoT ecosystems have also brought forth new difficulties in terms of cybersecurity that have never been seen before. The prevention of any assaults and penetrations into these networks has emerged as an issue of the utmost importance. In this research work, a fog-based attack prediction model for IoT settings was described. The model makes use of both machine and deep learning approaches, which together capture the full potential of this kind of learning. Utilizing the one-of-a-kind benefits that fog computing provides, the model that has been proposed tries to proactively detect and forecast cyberattacks that take place inside IoT networks. Our design provides real-time threat detection by processing and analyzing data closer to the edge of the network. This helps to minimize latency and reaction time by reducing the distance data has to travel. In order to construct a prediction model, this body of research work makes use of a random forest and LSTM categorization learning technique.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) for Semantic Representation of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This work presents a new approach to logically represent big data in rapidly expanding large data sets, namely medical visualization, using Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) Knowledge graphs are a great tool for capturing data communication complex due to structure and depth comprehension skills. These grids can be effectively transformed into continuous vector spaces, preserving the logical relationships between the data. The basis of this approach is to build an optimal knowledge map for medical image data, which is then subjected to sophisticated embedding techniques and then evaluate the efficiency of the resulting vector representation in many applications such as anomaly detection, . semantic similarity analysis and image classification. Furthermore, the use of embedded knowledge facilitates the interpretation of results, which is important for medical research. This work extends the application of KGE to other big data applications in addition to new opportunities for complex data representation in medical imaging

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Pneumonia Using Distribution of Pertinent Microstructures: An Application of Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Detection of patients with pneumonia is an immensely important task that requires expertise and hence may prove costly. The automated methods of Chest X-ray analysis, especially pneumonia have gained attention in the last few years. This reduces cost and time and can be used for better visualization. In recent years the image processing community has worked on this problem with varying rates of success. This paper takes the work forward and applies Chest X-ray imaging to the diagnosis of pneumonia using the proposed Machine Learning pipeline, which involves pre-processing, extracting features, and selecting pertinent features. The feature extraction has been done using the Local Binary Pattern, and feature selection using the Fisher Discriminant Ratio. The proposed model has lesser memory and space complexity as compared to the often-used Convolutional Neural Network models which are Deep Learning models which do not require explicit extraction and selection. Furthermore, our model can handle imbalanced data gracefully. The results are encouraging and the proposed model may prove useful for medical eternity. Our model gives 87.3 % accuracy, 87.4 % sensitivity, and 87.1 % specificity. This model prepares the ground for Machine Learning to be used in the diagnosis of pneumonia. We are also working on another work that combines Conventional Machine Learning with Transfer Learning to accomplish this task.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Unbalanced Dataset Promotion Prediction for Employees
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The practice of giving and accepting promotions is one of the most important in human resources. Management can keep morale and productivity high with the use of a merit-based, open promotion system inside the company. The prospect of a promotion is one of several extraneous reasons that drives many employees. maintaining the worker engaged and committed to the organization is crucial to maintaining his current productivity levels intact. It's a vital tool for motivating workers and monitoring their output. The promotion process takes into account a wide range of factors, including an employee's seniority, performance, competencies, age, awards, training score, and organizational devotion. Workers' promotion needs will be evaluated using Machine Learning methods such Support Vector Machine, Artificial Neural Network, and Random Forest, and a prediction strategy will be explored based on the findings. Accuracy, precision, and recall all improved by 1%, and the f1-score reached a perfect 98% when the ROS technique was combined with the Random Forest algorithm. Human resource professionals and business leaders might use the findings of this study to make more accurate predictions about who and when promotions will occur.

articleTitle: Advances in AI: Employing Deep Generative Models for the Creation of Synthetic Healthcare Datasets to Improve Predictive Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving domain of healthcare, the availability of large and diverse datasets is paramount for the development and validation of advanced algorithms. However, the acquisition of such data is often hindered by privacy concerns, limited patient cohorts, and the inherent variability in medical conditions. This research delves into the potential of Deep Generative Models (DGMs) as a solution for synthetic data generation in healthcare applications. We present a comprehensive study of various DGM architectures, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and Normalizing Flows, and their efficacy in generating high-fidelity medical images. Our experiments demonstrate that these models can produce synthetic data that retains the intricate features of real medical images while ensuring patient privacy. Furthermore, when used as augmentation in training diagnostic algorithms, the synthetic data generated by our proposed models showed a significant improvement in the generalization capabilities of these algorithms. This work not only underscores the potential of DGMs in addressing the data scarcity issue in healthcare but also paves the way for their broader application in medical research, training, and diagnostics.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Approach for Prediction of Parkinson's Disease: A Trained Computer Based Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Millions of people all over the globe suffer with Parkinson's disease (PD), a kind of neurodegenerative illness. Improved patient care and treatment results may be achieved with early and precise prediction of PD. In order to forecast Parkinson's disease, this research developed a new method using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks. The complex temporal relationships present in sequential data may be captured by BiLSTMs, a form of recurrent neural network. By taking use of their ability to look backwards and forwards, these networks are better able to recognize the nuanced and complicated aspects inherent in PD-related data. Patient data, including demographics, medical history, genetic markers, and diagnostic test results, are preprocessed as part of the method given here. This paper presents BiLSTM approach for prediction of PD which is a trained computer based model. A BiLSTM model is trained using this multidimensional data to learn to extract features and correlations from input sequences. The proposed model is evaluated on a large labeled dataset of PD patients using a variety of measures.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: A hearing-impaired person is never simple to con- verse with. The study presented in this paper is a reflection of the efforts undertaken to investigate the difficulties with character classification in Sign Language. When communicating with someone who cannot speak or who have hearing loss, sign language is insufficient. The motions made by individuals with impairments may look chaotic or disorganised to someone who has never learnt this language. It is advisable to employ both forms of communication. The identification of Sign Language based on CNN is shown in this paper Convolutional neural networks are used to train and then recognise our model, which is utilised to identify the pictures. The accuracy of our model is 92% .

articleTitle: Computing for Mobile Ad Hoc Network in IoT Fuelled Smart Environments: Computer Integration in Smart Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Present Information Technology scenario is engulfed with exponential rise in mobile computing devices mostly embedded in diverse equipments of our daily life. This has led to evolutionary demand of new solutions to mobile computing for smart environments equipped with Internet of Things (IoT). A plethora of challenges are emerging to ensure effective internet connectivity for such mobile devices. These devices are mostly equipped with sensors and demand continuous computing and data transfers. The globe is evolving to humancentred society, i.e., Society 5.0 loaded with innovations of Big Data, IoT, Artificial Intelligence and much more to make social life comfortable and sustainable. Hence, this trend is the need of the hour but has brought a range of new challenges to MANETs for mobile computing in smart environments. This paper explores the MANET-IoT computing trends and provides a detailed analysis of the challenges for computing in the smart environment having MANET-IoT as backbone for mobile communications.

articleTitle: Autism Prediction Using CNN VGG16 and T-SNE Visualisation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: A pervasive disorder, autism is typically described as such. Individuals with Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) generally experience challenges in social communication. Also they exhibit various behavioral problems, hyperactivity, and various challenges while responding to actions. By using different facial images, a new architecture was developed for the diagnosis of developmental disorders. Here in this architecture Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN) used for extracting the various facial features from the images. The aim of this study is to develop a real-time neurological structure model which uses facial image recognition technology to diagnose autism spectrum disorder (ASD).).

articleTitle: Formulation of Scalable and Secured IoT- Oriented Solutions Implemented for Smart Cities: An approach from Computer Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The Internet of things is also regarded as loT, and it has an influential impact on the daily life of many people by altering and transforming physical objects into well-structured ecosystem connectivity. There are various reasons the devices are facing, such as the huge deployment in security levels in the field of managed security and control systems. The general and traditional systems are degrading the vulnerability, and it can be abused for spying by hackers with the help of controlling and regulating the network. Scalability is one of the significant factors when considering IOT-oriented solutions. There are several factors to scale IOT such as supplying the devices, certification, and security along with cellular coverage. For converting an ordinary city into a smart city, IoT technology is the key player. In this work an integrated solution is presented for the scalable and secured solution for the effective implementation of IoT technology to smart cities.

articleTitle: Identification of Mild Traumatic Brain Injuries by Machine Learning using Whole-Brain Functional Activity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The accurate diagnosis of traumatic brain injury (TBI) has taken on a greater level of importance than it ever has before as a result of the challenges and complexities associated with the quantitative assessment of TBI as well as the growing significance of TBI in today's environment. Traumatic brain injuries are a prominent cause of death and disability in young individuals. The prevalence of mild traumatic brain injuries (mTBI) is rising. Around 1.6 million people worldwide acquire them annually. These injuries are brought on by an external force that impacts the head, such as blunt trauma, items that penetrate the skull, or blast waves. Using machine learning, we provide a comprehensive analysis of the functional activity across the whole brain in this research. To categorize all of the brain's activity, the concepts of machine learning are examined. As part of this review study, numerous connected literature studies will be carried out in order to gather and synthesize the methods and alternatives to identify mild traumatic brain injuries using machine learning and whole-brain functional activity.

articleTitle: Implementation of an Automated Hydroponic System using ANN: A Case Study on Spinach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The agricultural sector plays an important role in the country's economy. Hydroponics and aeroponics are growing due to modern agricultural practices which allow the cultivation of plants without soil by means of a solution containing nutrients. A certain amount of work is now being carried out in the application of artificial intelligence algorithms, such as neural networks or probabilistic networks for controlling hydroponic plant growth. The Internet of Things enables an autonomous and intelligent management of the hydroponic system by machine-to-machine interaction. This work proposes to use artificial neural networks, for the development of a smart IoT hydroponic system. The system developed is sufficiently intelligent to enable appropriate controls in the hydroponically environment, based on a number of inputs obtained. The designed system uses KNN, LSTM, RNN, SVM for the decision-making process of controlling the plants parameter growing through hydroponic techniques. The ANN, KNN, RNN, LSTM, SVM models provide the accuracy rate of 95%, 93%, 91%, 94%, 81%. However, the ANN model is preferred to train the collected data as it exhibited the best performance with 95%accuracy. Further, the macro average, a performance metric used to calculate the F1 score, yields a result of 0.94%, while the weighted average, which takes into account the number of instances associated with various class labels, results in an accuracy of 95%.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Product Identification in Automobile Sector Using Raspberry pi 4: A Computer Controlled Production System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Raspberry Pi (RPi) is a small single board computer. The proposed work connects the peripherals devices along with the Raspberry Pi to locate the products present in the automobile sector. RPi is primarily focused for many real time applications specifically in image and video processing applications. Though the performance of the RPi is comparatively slow than the personal computer, but it can provide all the expected features or abilities with less power consumption. RPi has a wide range of applications in various fields, some of them are Education, Home Automation, Gaming, Robotics, Computer vision. This paper proposed a novel approach for identifying the automobile product using RPi version 4. This proposed approach helps to locate the automobile products in the kitting area.

articleTitle: Automated System to Diagnose and Detect the Allergy, Common Cold, Flu, and Covid using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Rapid detection based on clinical symptoms from several illnesses with symptoms similar to COVID-19 became crucial for preventing the spread of the pandemic once COVID-19 emerged as a global health concern. In this study, we have presented an approach to classify and predict the four diseases: allergy, covid, flu, and common cold, which share similar symptoms. In this experiment, we have compared the performance of the decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, random forest, support vector machine, linear regression, and Naïve Bayes algorithms. To get the best performance of these algorithms, hyperparameters are tuned with the help of the grid search algorithm. Experimental results suggest that the performance of all algorithms has been improved after hyperparameter tuning.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning for Real-time Anomaly Detection and Self-Repair in IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) gadgets have completely transformed a number of different businesses by producing enormous amounts of data. A machine learning framework for real-time Internet of Things anomaly detection and self-repair is presented in this research for the first time. Incorporating data preparation, anomaly detection, and selfrepair are all components of the framework. Through the use of data preparation module normalization and dimensionality reduction, Internet of Things data analysis can be improved. Through the utilization of deep neural networks, support vector machines, and several other machine learning models that have been trained on previous data, abnormal behavior can be identified. The reliability of ensemble approaches is increased. The self-repair module is responsible for automatically repairing abnormalities by resetting the settings of the device, upgrading the firmware, and applying patches. Device disruptions are reduced to a minimum by validation. Within the context of smart home and industrial automation tests, events were identified with a high degree of precision and a low percentage of false positives. Because it automatically fixes problems, the self-repair module makes the Internet of Things ecosystem better.

articleTitle: Semantic Optimization in Lossless Data Compression for IoT-Driven Smart Healthcare Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In this study, we explore the potential of the Internet of Things (IoT) within the domain of smart healthcare management applications, an area of growing importance in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Data Mining. IoT's capacity to efficiently amass, process, and transfer data is revolutionizing smart city initiatives, healthcare, energy distribution, and vehicular technology. Our primary aim is to construct a robust framework for smart healthcare management that not only harnesses the power of IoT but also integrates ontological models for enhanced data compression without compromising data quality. Our proposed theoretical framework is structured around three integral components: the pre-processing module, the ontological module, and the data compression module. Leveraging a comprehensive dataset from a Kaggle repository, we applied this tripartite approach to smart healthcare data, seeking to refine the data transformation process into a digital format—a process traditionally fraught with challenges due to the voluminous nature of healthcare data. We introduce a novel compression method and evaluate its performance against traditional compression algorithms such as Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW), Run-Length Encoding (RLE), and Huffman coding. The efficacy of our approach is measured using metrics like compression factor (CF), compression ratio (CR), and compression time, providing a quantitative assessment of its viability. The integration of IoT into the ontological approaches and data compression techniques presented in this study not only enhances healthcare services, but also highlights the potential of AI and ML to transform data processing and data storage solutions. This study seeks to demonstrate the benefits of this multi-functional approach and its surprising results in the future of smart healthcare.

Author Keywords: Efficient Data Storage for Medical IoT Systems

articleTitle: Leveraging Prescriptive Analytics for Strategic Business Optimization: Real-World Applications and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The application of analytics in business has shown meteoric growth during the past several years. Businesses on every continent are turning to various methods of data analysis to improve their comprehension of the requirements and preferences of their clientele. As more businesses realise that predictive analytics helps them to lower risks, make informed decisions, and offer differentiated customer experiences, the issue of predictive analytics has become an increasingly popular one in the landscape of analytics. As a direct consequence of this, the deployment of predictive analytics is gaining steam. However, the adoption rate is modest, and businesses are just beginning to scratch the surface when it comes to the possible uses of this technology. The benefits to the company might be enormous if the implementation is done correctly. However, there are several potential strategic dangers that should be taken into consideration. This study's primary objective is to investigate the shifting dimensions of analytics, emphasise the significance of predictive analytics, pinpoint the factors that determine the success of implementation, and discuss some of the potential advantages that could be gained from using this technology. Additionally, case studies of GE Aviation and Google about the application of predictive analysis were taken into consideration for this study. According to the findings of the research, technologies for predictive analytics enable organisations to forecast trends and act on opportunities before they become visible to the public. The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) and prescriptive analytics, which encompass supply chain optimisation, sustainability and emission control, and increased operational efficiency, are two areas in which GE continues to be an innovator. Workforce planning, learning and development, and employee well-being are future predictions made for Google using prescriptive analytics.

articleTitle: An ML-Based Intrusion Detection System Design and Evaluation for Enhanced Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the ever-evolving realm of cyber space, ensuring security and integrity of information systems is paramount, given the dynamic nature of contemporary cyber threats. Traditional intrusion detection system, sometimes struggle to keep with these attacks. To address this challenge, the study has developed an innovative machine learning based intrusion detection system to enhance cyber security. The system can rapidly and accurately identify both known and novel risk by leveraging cutting edge machine learning techniques. We trained and validated our model using an extensive dataset encompassing various network scenarios. In comparison to conventional IDS, the ML IDS demonstrated superior detection, accuracy and reduced incidence of false positives. Additionally, the MLIDS provides to be a reliable solution for diverse network. topology is due to its adaptive learning capabilities, making it resilient against evolving cyber threats. this encompasses the design, design, implementation, and evaluation of the MLIDS, highlighting its potential as a valuable tool in next generation, cyber security solutions.

articleTitle: Acquiring Knowledge by Performing Classification and Clustering of Datasets using WEKA: Intelligence through MLP, RF, DT, and RepTree
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the ever-advancing domains of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, the pursuit of knowledge acquisition through data analysis stands as an imperative pillar. The research paper titled “Acquiring Knowledge by Performing Classification and Clustering of Datasets using WEKA” represents a seminal contribution in this endeavour, encapsulating cutting-edge techniques that reverberate across the spectrum of machine learning and data mining. This research unfolds with a rigorous exploration of the WEKA software, a quintessential tool in the practitioner's arsenal, renowned for its efficacy in handling diverse datasets. Through systematic classification and clustering methodologies, this study leverages the prowess of WEKA to discern hidden patterns, structures, and knowledge encapsulated within the data. In the intricate tapestry of Computer Science and AI, the paper elucidates the intricacies of classification, a fundamental tenet of machine learning, wherein data instances are categorized into predefined classes. Simultaneously, the study delves into clustering, a quintessential technique for unsupervised learning, wherein data points are grouped based on inherent similarities. These techniques are imbued with profound implications for data mining, a discipline that underpins decisionmaking and knowledge extraction. The practical implications of this research reverberate across diverse applications in Computer Science and AI, encompassing data-driven domains such as NLP, Computer Vision, and Robotics. The discernment of patterns within data yields actionable insights, shaping the evolution of intelligent systems and augmenting the capabilities of autonomous entities.

articleTitle: Recognition and Classification of Medical Images using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Pneumonia diagnosis is indeed challenging and error-prone to diagnose in chest X-ray pictures as other lung infection transparency is also prominent in the scan. Manually analysing X-rays by different professionals can yield distinct conclusions and inaccuracies. Implementing convolutional neural network (CNN) based models that can correctly categorize specific pneumonia categories can help with targeted treatment. The objective of this study is to utilize a pre-trained CNN variation along with Mobile Net in order to train a data set from an open source comprised of clinical images of an X-ray, followed by a training and validation analysis of the method. By analysing the data, the accuracy and adaptability of the CNN model has been evaluated. The highlights of the study defines that the imbalanced data has been balanced and enhanced the true positive prediction with improved accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: A Profile-Based Privacy Protection Method using Sandbox Environment and k-Anonymity: Computer Data Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Android apps request excessive permissions to get the access of sensitive information, some apps request excessive permissions which creates a seriously threat to the user privacy and security. This research is based on profile-based privacy protection method for Android apps which integrate principle of sandboxing and data masking techniques. User can manage multiple profiles for different purpose as per requirement. Each profile has assigned a set of rules, permissions and data. They don't share data with other profiles. Sandbox environment help in keeping the each profile isolated from each other. To protect the data of each user, masking of data has been done using <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> anonymity. The proposed method has been assessed with different app categories and for different user profiles. The results shows that the method can effectively protect users' privacy and data, while introducing acceptable performance overhead.

articleTitle: Intelligent Armor: Metal Object Detection in Robotics Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In order to increase efficiency and simplify tasks in our daily lives, robot integration will be a key component. Robotics have made life easier for humans, both in the industrial manufacturing sector and in the household sector. In the field of defence, robots are becoming a more important component of the battle field. In recent years, there have been a number of incidents regarding military disasters and fatalities around the world, leading to a need for innovative solutions to protect soldiers from these incidents. As a result of their use in military applications, robots have been proven to reduce danger and save lives. We propose in this paper to develop a robotic system that can be used to locate hidden weapons as well as land mines along borders which offer a method for their detection. Detection and monitoring of the system will be available in real-time thanks to the installation of a live camera. This remote-controlled robot is composed of a control unit, a processor, a variety of sensors to detect landmines and a control unit that controls them. With the deployment of robots on battlefields and border regions, there will be a significant reduction in the death toll from landmines as a result. This paper presents a comprehensive review of landmine detection through unmanned robotic vehicles, highlighting their significance in modern-day warfare

articleTitle: Port-Based Classification of Network Traffic Analysis using the ColaSoftCapsa Tool for Enhanced Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: With the growing threat of cyberattacks and digital crimes, it is imperative that we have robust mechanisms to detect and prevent hostile behavior. Network Traffic Analysis (NTA) is an important aspect of cybersecurity that focuses on collecting, recording, monitoring and evaluating network traffic patterns This study presents a new theoretical framework for NTA aimed at network improve security through malicious packet detection and prevention Planning Critical insights from network traffic data Uses ML and data mining techniques to derive, facilitating detection of anomalies and potential security breaches so This approach provides a comprehensive and strategic approach to NTA, effectively addressing the challenges associated with early detection and classification of malicious network activity.

articleTitle: Developing an Optimized Semantic Knowledge Base for Enhanced Public Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The integration of ontology in healthcare system decision-making has profound implications for computer science and artificial intelligence (AI) applications in healthcare. This research explores the potential of ontology-driven solutions to enhance decision-making for healthcare policymakers. We focus on developing an ontology that incorporates key domain concepts such as health environments, diseases, and geographical areas, and their relationships across domains. Our ultimate goal is to create a publicly accessible repository of understanding knowledge with a strong emphasis on health care. In this interdisciplinary conference on computer science, AI, machine learning, data mining, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, robotics and data mining, this paper presents an approach made the unified conceptual framework presentation. This framework provides a unified level of health literacy by seamlessly integrating ontologies of diseases, geographic regions and organizational contexts Furthermore, we address important aspects of logic integration, including health visualization, usage including the possibilities of app development and connectivity challenges.

articleTitle: Threats of Internet of Things and Mechanisms for Available Computer Security Systems in Today's World
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to a procedure in which a number of different devices are connected to the internet or a networking system. In the current day and age. However, there are also numerous potential risks to the system's security, despite the fact that it offers certain advantages, such as being cost-effective and favorable to one's budget in addition to providing protection at all times. As it pertains to networking systems, the access to personally identifiable information as well as the process of managing all data may be obtained with the assistance of cybercrimes. The privacy of individuals and the data they save might be compromised as a result of this. This study presents a detailed explanation of the Internet of Things system and its applications, as well as a discussion of the solution for reducing the risks posed by such applications.

articleTitle: Advanced Abnormality Recognition in IoT Networks Using LSTM-RNNs for Dynamic Security Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: As Internet of Things (IoT) devices proliferate, it is critical to guarantee the security and dependability of IoT networks. Due to the dynamic and diverse nature of IoT networks, traditional anomaly detection approaches often fail to capture these characteristics. This study presents a unique use of long short-term memory recurrent neural networks (LSTMRNNs) for anomaly detection in Internet of Things networks. Because RNNs can naturally record sequential patterns of data, they are especially useful for tracking the temporal relationships that are common in Internet of Things network traffic. Our suggested model architecture makes use of the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) version of RNNs, which has been tailored to the particulars of Internet of Things traffic. On an extensive dataset that included a variety of IoT devices and traffic patterns, the suggested model was trained and verified. According to experimental data, our RNN-based strategy achieves higher detection rates with fewer false positives than conventional techniques like the Statistical Thresholding Method and Signature-based Detection. Moreover, the model demonstrates resilience against dynamic threats and flexibility in accommodating the dynamic domain of Internet of Things devices and their corresponding actions. This study opens the door for further research in this area while also highlighting the potential of RNNs to improve IoT network security.

articleTitle: Predicting Depression and Mental Illness Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Depression is feelings of sadness, irritation or stress, it encompasses a series of psychological, physical and emotional symptoms that can disturb or even snatch the ability to function properly from an individual in their daily life. Approximately 280 million people which is around 3.8 percent of the world's population experiences the depression. But unfortunately, the stigma in our society about mental health issue often prevents individual from seeking help which leads a number of people experiencing depression being untreated and unidentified. Therefore, it is important to have a system which can predict depression. In this paper we implement five classification algorithms: Random Forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naïve Bayes (NB). Two datasets have been utilized for widening the perspective of our study. One of these datasets have been taken from Kaggle while we collect another dataset by conducting survey between the six reputed universities of India. In this paper we also use Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE) to balance the datasets. Further we use grid search for hyperparameter tuning to optimize and increase the efficiency of model. In dataset 1 SVM and RF have outperformed other models while in dataset 2 DT have outperformed others algorithm.

articleTitle: AI Assisted Chest X-Ray Analysis for Pulmonary
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This research paper explores the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in chest Xray analysis to detect pulmonary diseases. Chest X-ray analysis aided by AI has the potential to increase the precision and effectiveness of diagnoses, improving patient outcomes. We conducted a thorough literature review and developed our own methodology for AI assisted chest X-ray analysis, using machine learning algorithms to train models on large datasets of chest X-rays. Our results show that AI-assisted analysis can effectively detect pulmonary diseases such as pneumonia, tuberculosis, and lung cancer with high accuracy. However, concerns around the ethical implications of AI in healthcare and the potential impact on the role of radiologists remain. Overall, this research provides insights into the potential benefits and challenges of AI-assisted chest Xray analysis for pulmonary disease detection and highlights opportunities for future research in this field. Whereas the dataset of 61 people having habits of smoking or drinking of different age group has been selected to use. The dataset is imported and executed further with the help of python.

articleTitle: Mental Health Predictive Analysis using Multiple Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The growth in mental health issues and the demand for high-quality medical care have prompted the requirement of machine learning techniques in the psychological research area. For the better prediction of mental health complications, this work presents an up-to-date thorough evaluation of machinelearning algorithms. This article reviews the difficulties, limitations and future directions of using machine learning approaches in psychological health. By searching reliable databases, relevant studies and publications on machine learning methods were collected for predicting mental health related issues. For the completion of this work, 40 research outcomes were analyzed using screening and classification procedures. The analyzed works were categorized according to mental health conditions such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or anxiety, PTSD, and mental health conditions affecting children. While discussing the results, the difficulties and limitations that many researchers have encountered when studying mental health related problems were also considered. The paper also encompasses specific directions for future research work that are feasible and the need for utilizing varying approaches in machine learning for psychological health disorder predictions.

articleTitle: Optimizing Image Recognition Model through Transfer Learning and Robust Feature Extraction in Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: These advances in image identification's technology have created massive changes, mainly in the health care facilities plus self-directed systems. Transfer learning strategies coupled with robust feature extraction techniques are used in the model to promote efficiency in the imaging system. A technique of fine-tuning the weights used for recognition tasks on pre-trained convolutional neural network architectures is proposed. State of art feature extraction pipeline composed with edge detection, texture analysis and spatial frequency analysis to enrich network capacity of distinguishing intricate visual textures and patterns. This combination of techniques helps in faster model training with top class prediction results on mixed image datasets. After rigorous testing on various benchmark datasets, including CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, considerable enhancement in recognition performance beyond baselines was observed. Additionally, the proposed approach is resilient to changes in image quality, illumination, and occlusions. The proposed framework enhances the existing model efficiency, flexibility, and robustness for application in real-time image identification. This approach opens new capabilities for the medical imagery, self-navigation cars, and object recognize mechanisms whose image classification must be exact.

articleTitle: The Construction of Smart Tourism Based on Holographic Optics and AR Technology in the 5G Era: Computer World in Smart Tourism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The tourist business is experiencing some difficulties as a result of the ongoing expansion of the tertiary industry, despite the fact that it is still thriving. This article uses The Big Wild Goose Pagoda as an example and provides a brief description of how to combine the technologies of holographic optics and augmented reality in the era of 5G. The goal of this article is to demonstrate how to cleverly take advantage of the technologies of holographic optics and augmented reality in order to build a 5G base station-based smart tourism system, an infrared personnel diversion, and an infrared personnel diversion. The smart tourism business, which consists of interactive travel and intelligent services accessible via mobile phone, is now in the process of developing.

articleTitle: Changing Roles of Intelligent Robotics and Machinery Control Systems as Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) in the Industry 4.0 Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Intelligent robotics and machine learning are some of the major impactful disciples as they help to reduce the usage of electricity in the developing world and thus the roles of the intelligent and machinery control system are changing as the cyber-physical system in the industry 4.0 farm work. Proper and strong machinery control systems are being utilized to train the robots in order to enhance efficiency and accuracy. Artificial intelligence as well as machine learning upgrades the working efficiency of robotics and there is no sector that has been left. The changing roles of intelligent robotics and machinery system as cyber-physical system symbolizes (CPS) in the 4.0 framework industry.

articleTitle: IoT based Solar Panel Cleaner: A Computer Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This article introduces the design and testing of a self-sufficient system for cleaning solarpanels. Overall, the aim of this prototype project is to clean solar modules without manual work. The new system uses an electronic mechanism to eject dust particles from the surface of the solar panels and has the potential to reduce the operating costs of photovoltaic systems by improving overall performance. Additionally, under normal circumstances, homeowners may not need to invest in solar panel cleaning equipment or hire a professional cleaning company.
