This ensures maximum efficiency and lifetime of the solar panel, ultimately resulting in cost savings and a more sustainable energy source. This not only increases the efficiency of the solar module, but also reduces maintenance costs and manual cleaning.so that the performance or quality of the solar panel is not affected.

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Mental Health: An In-Depth Analysis of Prediction Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide continue to suffer from a variety of diseases that frequently go undetected or untreated, making mental health disorders a major public health concern. In addition to a full examination of the many types of mental disorders, symptoms, diagnostics, and investigations of mental disorders, this review paper gives a detailed description of the mental disorder detection utilizing deep learning-based methodologies. The review starts out by going over the frequency, importance, and difficulties in timely diagnosing mental health illnesses. The system design for employing deep learning to identify mental disorders early on is then further explored. In addition, the comparative analysis component of the article, which is covered in the literature review section, provides a critical evaluation of the datasets and evaluation metrics currently in use for training and evaluating deep learning models for the identification of mental disorders. The advancements in this field, including the identification of depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, and other mental health issues, are demonstrated through a thorough assessment of recent studies and their findings. This work also discusses future possibilities and challenges in the field of deep learning for the diagnosis of mental disorders, highlighting the importance of large-scale, diversified, and representative datasets.

articleTitle: Risk Level Prediction for Maternal Health Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is a subset of artificial intelligence (AI) that is booming nowadays. It has the ability to learn from various data available and make predictions about future events for unseen data. It possesses the capability to autonomously learn from past experiences. While machine learning algorithms (MLAs) are quite complex, their utility in today's world is substantial. This paper centers around the utilization of these MLAs to make predictions in the healthcare sector using available historical data that includes various health factors for demonstrating the risk associated with maternal health (MH). Using various MLAs and considering the health factors that are associated during pregnancy and post-delivery we aim to facilitate the implementation of preventive measures based on these predictions. MH is an issue of great concern globally. Many women globally are at risk every year due to lack of prevention and irresponsiveness towards health of women after delivery, this can also lead to several diseases and deaths. Hence, it is essential to diagnose the associated complications at an early stage for timely implementation of preventative measures, this not only expands the application of ML in healthcare but also has the potential to save lives and ensure the good well-being of mothers and newborn individuals. It helps to ascertain the challenges according to the pre health condition of everyone.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Blockchain in Crowdfunding: Opportunities and Challenges in India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Crowdfunding is becoming popular for humanitarian, innovative, fiscally helpful, and socially influential donations. Current crowdfunding platforms lack stability, transparency, and efficiency. A severe downside People are interested in blockchain technology because it can solve these problems and change crowdfunding. Blockchain technology may boost transparency, efficiency, and trust. This paper examines blockchain's crowdsourcing possibilities and limitations. This will be done by reviewing the literature, analyzing pertinent case studies, and creating conceptual frameworks. The study will also evaluate the legal, technical, and economic effects of deploying blockchain technology for crowdfunding. This study will benefit scholars, practitioners, and policymakers interested in this expanding field. The information will help them understand blockchain technology's possibilities for crowdfunding platforms.

articleTitle: A Holistic Exploration of Natural Language Processing: Challenges, Milestones, and Research Frontiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a rapidly evolving field with diverse applications, from chatbots to translation services. This survey offers a comprehensive exploration of NLP, covering its fundamentals, challenges, literature, structured model comparison, and research gaps. The introduction clarifies NLP's core concepts and applications. We then delve into its multifaceted challenges, spanning complex multimodal understanding to ethical issues like bias and fairness. This sets the stage for literature review, highlighting milestones like BERT and GPT-3. We provide a tabular comparison of influential models, elucidating their features, strengths, and limitations. Beyond reviewing past achievements, we spotlight critical research gaps—multimodal understanding, commonsense reasoning, bias mitigation, multilingualism, and ethics. Addressing these gaps is vital for responsible NLP advancement. In summation, paper offers a comprehensive and holistic view of the expansive field of NLP. It skillfully combines introductory concepts, a navigational guide through the realm of challenges, a detailed literature review, structured model comparisons, and a forward-looking perspective on the pressing research gaps. We aspire for this paper to emerge as an invaluable resource, serving as a guiding light for the research pursuits of scholars, the practical endeavors of practitioners, and the policy considerations of stakeholders within the expansive and dynamic NLP community. Its overarching objective is to steer future research initiatives toward the crucial task of addressing these pivotal gaps, thereby propelling the field into new horizons of knowledge and application.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Approaches for Crop Recommendations and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The Crop recommendations are crucial nowadays for maximizing agricultural yield. This paper presents extensive research on the application of machine learning techniques for crop recommendation. In this study, machine learning approaches have been proposed to recommend the crop for given soil properties and atmosphere by manipulating the data available from diverse sources. The proposed method includes the study of six machine learning techniques: linear regression, support vector machines, random forests, naive Bayes, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{K}$</tex>-nearest neighbors, and light gradient boosting machines. The framework used to carry out this study includes the data-processing, feature selection, and model training to produce accurate and robust crop recommendation models. The performance of various models is verified using precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy. The results demonstrate that the Naïve Bayes and random forest outperforms other models with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$99{{\% }}$</tex> accuracy.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Detection using Ensemble Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative, irrevocable, major brain dysfunction and complicated disease that continuously affects synapses, leading to memory and concentration skills degradation and, consequently, the inability to do even the most fundamental activities. This disease causes cognitive loss, which eventually results in dementia. AD causes cell death and damage to tissues throughout the brain, significantly reducing brain volume over time and impacting most of its activities. This study looks in depth at effective and consistent learning methodology for Alzheimer's disease classification. K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Ensembled Approach (EA) are the key machine learning methodologies investigated in this study. The ensembled approach outperforms the other approaches for diagnosing neurological disease. When compared to the state-of-the-art, the obtained results have demonstrated superior performance in terms of classification accuracy of 97.3%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Waste Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks and Explainability Techniques: Power of Computer in Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: India is having a huge population and due to this it suffers from a lot of human wastage disposal problem to combat this issue a good waste Segregation model is required. Currently there is no system which can divide the waste into more than two categories in real life scenario for Indian population to solve this in our study we are dividing our waste label into eight categories These categories are according to the industrial requirements and now as the model should be reliable, we are using explicability AI models like LIME SHAP AND GRAD CAM. This would help to make the model accountable and reliable so that the big organization can also use this and it would be also suitable for the waste Segregation of daily household waste materials. In this study using convolution neural networks, classification of different waste materials are done, as it is a deep neural network it is giving a good accuracy.

articleTitle: A New Planned Online Examination System Using AI that Uses Django
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Online exams are becoming increasingly common, employed by businesses to administer placement or internship exams, educational institutions to administer exams, and online education sites to validate certifications. By keeping information digital, lowering the resources needed to conduct a manual inspection, and offering a platform where forgery, changing data, and a biased judgment are not conceivable, they also decrease paperwork and improve documentation efficiency. In this essay, I presented a hypothetical model in which I would use the Django framework to build an examination system with integrated image processing to lower malpractice rates. By adding AI capabilities, the majority of the labor is eliminated, and the admin is just provided with the essential information. This significantly increases the system's simplicity, which can now be utilized everywhere from large cities to remote villages with only a basic understanding of computer operation. lowering complexity and putting more pressure on technology. but is adaptable enough to allow for the addition of human assistance as needed. This project has three phases, Phase I is complete and shown in the report, while the other two are still underway. The main challenge in this project is to use eye-detection technology to determine where the test taker is looking and AI to improve so that it can detect cheating as precisely as feasible.

articleTitle: Improved Brain Tumor Detection using Deep Learning Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for Medical Imaging Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Tumours in the brain can vary greatly in size, shape, and colour. In a single human brain, it is possible to find more than one type of tumour. Careful removal of the tumor-afflicted region is the first step in treating brain tumours. When compared to non-deep learning methods, the Deep Learning Framework's wealth of interesting ideas suggests that it would be better at segmenting regions of the brain associated with anxiety. To improve the accuracy of tumour detection in MRI scans, the study suggests using updated versions of traditional CNN models. The model's performance in identifying tumours surpasses baseline methods after training on a massive collection of MRI images. Brain tumours can be detected earlier with the proposed CNN models, leading to better treatment results and potentially saving lives. All things considered, the findings point to the possibility of deep learning techniques improving medical picture processing and disease identification. Using a different combination of kernel, filter, convolutional layer, batch, and fully connected layers, the proposed method employs six different CNN models. The suggested models have been evaluated in comparison to other convolutional neural network (CNN) models, such as CNN Model 1 (which has a training accuracy of.9984 and a testing accuracy of.9687), CNN Model 2 (which has a training accuracy of.9716 and a testing accuracy of.9624), CNN Model 3 (which has a training accuracy of.9961 and a testing accuracy of.9832), CNN Model 4 (which has a training accuracy of.9992 and a testing accuracy of.9878), CNN Model 5 (which has a training accuracy of.9994 and a testing accuracy of.9886), and CNN Model 6 (which has a training accuracy of.9996 and a testing accuracy of.9809).

articleTitle: Storage Matched Systems for Single-Click Photo Recognition Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: During this research, we provide two novel concepts: learners to acquire network characteristics for the unlabelled pictures over the spot in one-shot education, while supplementing the CNNs using memories. We particularly introduce Memories Matched Networking (MM-Net), a revolutionary deep design that investigates learning under the premise that learning and testing circumstances require being identical. In order to fully utilise the information contained in the collection, MM-Net essentially stores the characteristics of a collection of named pictures (the reference group) into memories and returns from memories while doing inferences. A Cognitive Learner, however, uses the storage spaces sequentially in predicting the CNN settings for unlabelled pictures. Whenever just a few instances from every category are shown at each stage while the instruction is switched across mini-batch into mini-batch, the entire system is taught. This is designed for quick learning whenever merely a few instances representing novel groups are displayed during testing. In contrast to traditional one-shot training techniques, our own MM-Net might generate a single, cohesive network regardless of the quantity of photos or classes. Using 2 open records, Omniglot while miniImageNet, thorough analyses are undertaken, and better outcomes are presented when contrasted with cutting-edge methods. Furthermore, the privilege of MM-Net raises one-shot performance on Omniglot via 98.95% into 99.28% as well as miniImageNet via 49.21% into 53.37%.

articleTitle: Classification of Pepper Bell into Healthy and Bacterial Spot Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: This study makes a strong case for dividing bell pepper leaves into two broad groups: those that are healthy and those plagued by disease centers. The system uses advanced machine learning techniques to achieve a classification accuracy of over 95 %. The importance of correct classification in agriculture cannot be denied because it plays an important role in early detection of diseases, preventing losses and ensuring product safety. Bacterial diseases pose a threat to pepper crops, so accurate identification is important for effective disease control. Our approach requires the use of deep learning models to classify bell peppers. The model adapts to different situations using different data, including both healthy and disease-affected leaves. Classification accuracy above 95 % demonstrates the effectiveness of our method. This high level of accuracy is required to develop disease on real farms. This advance allows farmers and experts to quickly implement intervention plans that protect crops and all the benefits.

articleTitle: Generative AI: A Review on Models and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) stands as a transformative paradigm in machine learning, enabling the creation of complex and realistic data from latent representations. This review paper comprehensively surveys the landscape of Generative AI, encompassing its foundational concepts, diverse models, training methodologies, applications, challenges, recent advancements, evaluation metrics, and ethical dimensions. The paper begins by introducing Generative AI's significance across various domains, presenting its pivotal role in producing synthetic data with applications spanning image synthesis, text generation, music composition, drug discovery, and more. The objectives lie in elucidating the foundational concepts, delving into model intricacies, unveiling the training procedures, exploring its application landscape, addressing challenges, envisioning future directions, and discussing ethical ramifications. The foundational section elucidates the diverse array of generative models, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), flow-based models, Generative Reinforcement Learning (GRL), and advanced hybrid architectures. Subsequently, evaluation metrics ranging from Inception Score to perceptual similarity metrics and human evaluations are surveyed to assess generative model performance. Finally, ethical considerations underscore the necessity for addressing biases, misuse, intellectual property concerns, and the call for responsible AI development and regulation in the Generative AI landscape.

articleTitle: Enhancing Wireless Mesh Network Performance Through AI-Based Routing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs) are critical in ensuring ubiquitous internet coverage, particularly in environments and terrains with unique challenges. The increasing number of wireless devices and services has created a critical need for routing techniques that are more efficient and adaptable. Although conventional routing algorithms exhibit resilience, they frequently remain fixed and fail to adapt to swift fluctuations in network circumstances. By incorporating Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based routing algorithms, this article proposes a novel method for improving the efficacy of WMNs. We present an innovative AI-driven routing algorithm that dynamically adapts to fluctuating network conditions by leveraging reinforcement learning and deep learning techniques. Our methodology considers various elements, including interference, node dependability, bandwidth consumption, and node mobility. In contrast to conventional approaches, the algorithm powered by artificial intelligence perpetually acquires knowledge from its surroundings, forecasting possible breakdowns or congestion, and subsequently redirects data packets along a more efficient trajectory. Experiments performed on simulated and real-world WMN scenarios revealed significant enhancements in packet delivery ratio, latency, and throughput compared to traditional routing methods. In addition, our AI model's adaptability guarantees the network's resistance to external disturbances and its capacity to expand to accommodate an increasing number of nodes. The study's results highlight the capacity of artificial intelligence to fundamentally transform the domain of wireless networking. Incorporating intelligent algorithms into wide-area networks (WMNs) infrastructure can guarantee end-users a more streamlined, effective, and resilient internet experience. Further investigations are warranted to determine whether the proposed method can be implemented in alternative wireless architectures and to enhance the algorithm by utilizing hybrid AI techniques.

articleTitle: A Review of Load Balancing Techniques in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a sharp increase in the use of cloud computing. In cloud computing, computer resources, such as the ones which may offer computational power or storage are provided to users who are not directly responsible for the management of the systems that offer these resources. However, as the degree of application of this computing model increases, the number of consumers also increases, and as a result, the overall load that the cloud systems have to manage is also rapidly increasing. Without proper measures, this can result in some systems becoming overloaded while some others may become underloaded. This imbalance in the utilisation of these systems may result in a number of issues such as high-power consumption, high response time etc. To prevent these problems and several others in the cloud computing environment, load balancing techniques are used which enable the systems to share loads with each other in such a way that no system becomes over or under loaded and the degree of utilisation of computing resources is increased resulting in processing efficiency. The authors have conducted a survey of several classes of load balancing algorithms.

articleTitle: Empowering Coding Collaboration with PaaS: A Study of Slackflow Messenger's Impact on Team Productivity with React, Redux, and Firebase
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The influence of Slackflow Messenger, a platformas-a-service (PaaS) tool for coding collaboration, on team productivity is examined in this paper. The solution was created to enable smooth interaction and collaboration among software development teams utilizing current web technologies, such as React, Redux, and Firebase. The study's main objectives wereto assess the system's key capabilities and its potential to increase coding cooperation and team productivity. Analysis of use statistics, user surveys, and qualitative feedback gathering from software development teams were all part of the assessment process. The findings demonstrated that Slackflow Messenger's chat and message capabilities offered a productive method of communication and collaboration that enhanced project outcomes. The functionality and usability of the system were further improved by the incorporation of other technologies like version control and project management software. Overall, the research emphasizes the potential advantages of leveraging contemporary web technologies in constructing such solutions while highlighting the significance of collaboration tools and PaaS solutions in software development.

articleTitle: Optimizing Effort Estimation in Agile Software Development: Traditional vs. Advanced ML Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Effort estimation is a fundamental procedure that involves forecasting the required time, resources, and effort needed to successfully accomplish a project, assignment, or activity. A major challenge for the software industry is accurate effort estimation. In recent years, the software industry has moved towards Agile Methodology since its development in 2001. The Agile methodology emphasizes iterative and incremental delivery, which allows the software to be delivered in smaller increments and provides greater flexibility in response to changes in requirements. Within an agile framework, effort estimation encompasses both traditional and advanced algorithmic methods. This study conducts a comparative analysis, evaluating traditional and advanced machine learning techniques for effort estimation. By analyzing several previous studies, the research identifies the most suitable techniques to achieve accurate estimations. Traditional effort estimation techniques often fall short in accurately predicting the efforts needed for a software project due to data limitations, lack of detail, neglect of complexity, unaccounted risks, and an inability to adapt to changes. The limitations of conventional approaches can be overcome by machine learning algorithms that can be trained on past data to identify hidden patterns and relationships and produce more accurate and efficient effort predictions.

articleTitle: Flame Prediction: Using Machine Learning to Tackle Forest Fires
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Forests play an important role in environmental preservation. Fires occurring in forest are becoming more common day by day which is a major threat of lives of planet and people. Quick action on these forest fires can saves a lot of lives and vegetation and can eventually help minimise any further harm. In this research paper, various machine learning models are applied, including <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$K$</tex> Nearest Neighbour, Naive Bayes and Decision tree, in the Maharashtra region of India. In the models training and testing various parameters and features are taken into consideration including temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, rainfall and the account of fire being present or not in that specific region. The data and the results show that the Decision tree model gave the highest accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$96.32{{\% }}$</tex>, followed by the KNN classifier at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$95.38{{\% }}$</tex> and the Naive Bayes classifier at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$93.91{{\% }}$</tex>. The Area Under the Curve (AUC) scores for the models were as follows: The KNN model scored 0.85, the Naive Bayes model scored 0.73, and the Decision Tree model also scored 0.85. According to the findings, Decision Tree is the most effective algorithm for predicting forest fires in Maharashtra. The study develops a framework for predicting forest fires using machine learning algorithms that may be used in different regions and countries. The findings can assist forest management authorities in taking preventive measures and reducing the severity of forest fires.

articleTitle: Using Internet to Improve Ecological as well as Energy Surveillance in Houses: A Smart Computer Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In regards to sharing information and ease of implementation, options for tracking and regulating digital technology in the household and educational sectors behind. It is debatable if present technology enables multi-functional data interchange. This study investigates a web-based Internet of Things (IOT) approach for heating and cooling administration and surveillance of external factors energy, and satisfaction factors in an actual home. In small to medium-sized properties, the deployed IoT system demonstrated to be adaptable with regard to information interchange, installation, and development duration, making an Internet of Things integration-based method more successful. To a larger group of recipients, this strategy creates new opportunities. The next study will likely focus on providing forecasting data analysis services as well as expanding our system to more buildings around the college campus.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Proxy ReEncryption Technology Based Financial Data Sharing Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Proxy ReEncryption is proposed as a feasible and efficient cryptographic solution to the naturally occurring cloudbased problem of safe access delegation in this paper. In proxy reencryption, a proxy may switch ciphertexts from one public key to another without needing to decrypt the original plaintext. Therefore, it may be used to delegate decryption privileges, opening up a plethora of new use cases. The growing use of cloudbased file sharing is one such example. Here, we collect and analyze the most important features of current proxy reencryption methods. We test a variety of systems in practice and in theory before drawing conclusions about what works best. Finally, we discuss several concrete applications of proxy reencryption, with an emphasis on safe access delegation in the cloud.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Predictive Analysis for Pest and Disease Forecasting in Crops
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence(AI) has transformed agriculture by enhancing resilience, sustainability, and yield. A new AI-driven crop disease and pest outbreak prediction model is presented in this research. The algorithm uses satellite imagery, meteorological data, historical pest and disease incidence records, and field IoT sensor feeds to dynamically anticipate hazards. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for time-series data analysis, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for high-resolution satellite imagery analysis, and other machine learning techniques to detect diseases and pests are major elements of the system. The model's accuracy has been carefully evaluated against historical epidemics, showing significantly better predictions than conventional methods. This method allows farmers to obtain early warnings and prevent biotic dangers from causing harm. Predictive insights help agronomists and policymakers maximize pest and disease control, promoting sustainable agriculture and food security. To conclude, AI-driven predictive analysis could revolutionize agricultural pest and disease control. This study shows how AI revolutionizes crop harvests using several data sources and cutting-edge algorithms. Future study will improve the model's precision, expandability, and adaptability to different crops and regions.

articleTitle: Paradigmatic Approaches for Network Security and Preventing Intrusions: A Secure Computer Shield
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Network security has been the subject of extensive research due to security risks and monetary loss inflicted on by network assaults, breaches, and vulnerabilities. In most cases, data gathered in a network system can be utilised to reflect upon or to identify security threats. The ability to detect network attacks and intrusions through the study and analysis of security-related data allows for a more thorough assessment of the security status of entire network system. The objective of the research is to put forth the constraints associated with network security and to have a discussion on the efficient implementation strategies for restricting security risks. The study also recognises that network security monitoring protocols like EAP and machine learning integrated detection systems could see substantial adoption in recent years and are considered as viable solutions that could foresee future improvements.

articleTitle: An Efficient Machine Learning Classification with Feature Selection Techniques for Depression Detection from Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The emergence of Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter among other social media sites has profoundly altered our daily routines. With more people online than ever before, it's easy to establish a unique persona in cyberspace. The positive aspects of social media are undeniable, but the negative aspects of its use are also rather evident. More time spent on social media is associated with a higher risk of getting depression, according to recent research. Depressive symptoms include a persistently low mood and a loss of interest in previously enjoyed activities. Distinct mental health issues may have far-reaching effects, and severe depression, sometimes called major depression, is no exception. This research looks at two distinct machine learning classifiers that can tell whether a person is sad based on various demographic and psychological factors. Further, feature selection techniques such as recursive feature elimination with linear regression have select the most important characteristics from the dataset. RFC and GBC were utilized to improve the precision with which depression could be predicted. This technique is a machine learning (ML)-based prediction strategy for diagnosing depression and other mental diseases early. In addition, numerous models have had their F1-score, sensitivity, accuracy, specificity, and AUC calculated to see which is best for identifying episodes of depression. Higher accuracy (96%) was shown in diagnosing of depression using the ML algorithm.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Robustness of Neural Networks Against Adversarial Perturbations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: N eural networks have impressive powers in the field of deep learning and have been used in many different applications. Nevertheless, the issue of robustness against deliberate harmful inputs, commonly referred to as adversarial perturbations, continues to be a prominent topic. The presence of these perturbations, which are frequently undetectable by human observers, has the potential to cause erroneous predictions in models, hence presenting potential hazards to crucial domains such as autonomous vehicles or medical diagnostics. The primary objective of this study is to assess the vulnerability of neural networks to adversarial perturbations, ascertain the underlying factors contributing to this susceptibility, and investigate viable solutions for mitigating such vulnerabilities. Various adversarial attack strategies were utilized on diverse neural network topologies, and their performances were assessed. The results of our study suggest that whereas deeper models exhibit enhanced classification abilities, they may not necessarily possess more resilience against hostile inputs. Additionally, it has been found that certain conventional regularization techniques might further amplify susceptibility. In order to address these problems, innovative training techniques and adjustments to the network structures are implemented, resulting in enhanced resilience against adversarial attacks. This study highlights the significance of developing neural networks that possess both accuracy and robustness, hence advancing the frontier of safe deep learning applications.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Healthcare Data Management: A Comprehensive Review of Blockchain Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Blockchain technology is a constant area for more evolution and development. It is a network of blocks that protects information and upholds interpersonal trust no matter how far apart people are Decentralization, and transparency are important characteristics that could help in addressing critical difficulties in healthcare, like incomplete records at the point of care and restricted access to patients' own health information. There are several difficulties and problems with data management, security, openness, and user and record privacy even with smart healthcare systems (SHS). This study examines the health care system's application areas where blockchain technology can be used for SHS's efficient functioning. It does so by examining the most recent expert opinions and resent researches done. It discusses the research directions and use cases of blockchain in healthcare domain to produce an in-depth overview of the data management and storage technology in health care system.

articleTitle: AI with Consciousness: Advancing Explainability in the Healthcare Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: With the quick progression of man-made brainpower (computer based intelligence/ AI) in the clinical field, there is a rising requirement for straightforwardness and interpretability of man-made intelligence models to guarantee their viable and capable arrangement. This paper means to investigate the idea of logical simulated intelligence (XAI) with regards to medical services, examining its significance, difficulties, and possible applications. The paper gives strategies and procedures for XAI, uses of XAI in medical services, moral contemplations, and future bearings

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Online Social Networking Data for the Identification of Depression Using Several AI Techniques: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Emotional analysis is a growing trend today to recognize the feelings of people in many circumstances in life. Data from online platforms will be used throughout the whole procedure, which involves an analytical and classification-based processes, and is composed of textual data, emoticons, and other types of data. In previous studies, multi-class classification offers more correct information than both ternary and binary classification. In a multiclass classification, information separated in to numerous subcategories depending on polarities. Techniques such as deep learning and algorithms of machine learning will be utilized in the process of categorization. Social media can be used for monitoring and exploring emotional states. This study presents a description of emotional analysis of publicly available data by applying different artificial intelligence approaches to identify anxiety or frustration. The study optically demonstrated that emoticons, social media texts, and data including emoticons were used to determine emotions using various intelligent approaches. Analysis results with multiclass classification using a deep learning techniques or models are more accurate.

articleTitle: Air Canvas for Educational Systems with Hand Tracking in Real Time using Mediapipe: A Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Today, Computer Vision is widely used in various tech sectors. It is very useful in developing modern applications, such as those used by Air Canvas. After reviewing numerous research publications on this subject, this study aims to provide a comprehensive overview of all the aspects of object detection. It provides suggestions for how they can be improved, and techniques for Topic object detection and also includes various algorithms for it. Evaluations of algorithms such as SSD and YOLO has also been covered for a better grasp of how object detection works. The parts that are necessary for building the Air Canvas project are also present. It also consists of the implementation of the final project. Although a huge task, it can be very much made possible by consistent investment by communities passionate about developing one of the most exploited sectors of our economy and by government funding that is able to recognize the potential that gets lost in the tide of economic poverty and discrimination against backgrounds. The project is a learning tool that can be utilized in a classroom for teaching as well as being an insight into what modern computer vision technology is capable of.

articleTitle: Optimizing Query Performance in Big Data Systems Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The retrieval of information from extensive datasets in an efficient manner is critical in the era of big data. Conventional optimization methods encounter difficulties in managing the multitude of intricate and varied queries that big data systems confront. To optimize query efficacy in big data systems, this article introduces an innovative strategy that uses machine learning (ML) algorithms. To forecast optimal query execution strategies, our methodology entails training machine learning models using historical query execution data. The methodology consists of two components: First, characteristics are extracted from query plans, encompassing query patterns and statistics pertaining to the underlying data. Furthermore, to forecast the efficacy of a specific strategy, ML models, including decision trees, neural networks, and gradient-boosting machines, are trained using these characteristics. The findings were persuasive. In particular, for intricate queries, our ML-based optimizer enhanced query performance by as much as 60 % when compared to conventional optimizers. Changing duties and data distributions were also accommodated by our system, demonstrating its robustness and adaptability. Our research establishes a foundation for an emerging class of adaptive query optimizers capable of acquiring knowledge and adjusting to the dynamic characteristics of data and queries. By integrating machine learning capabilities with big data systems, we present a novel solution that significantly enhances the speed and efficiency of data retrieval.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Virtualization and Cloud Computing in the Modern Computer Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Organizations experience a tremendous metamorphosis in the dynamic terrain of the digital era, driven by the mutually beneficial expansion of virtualization and cloud computing. This essay explores the complex process of digital transformation, revealing the historical background of these two crucial technologies and how they interact to change the face of technology. The investigation commences by tracking the inception of virtualization and analyzing its progressive development from server consolidation to the all-encompassing abstraction of complete IT infrastructures. The story then moves smoothly to the advent of cloud computing, exploring how it broke free from traditional computer paradigms to offer previously unheard-of levels of scale, flexibility, and affordability. This technology schedules resource allocation to virtual machines (VMs) in a way that reduces energy consumption using algorithms. Due to their considerable obstacles, performance monitoring and security are two important virtualization-related concerns. This can lower expenses and increase data centers' environmental sustainability. Since 5G networks may offer the high-speed, low-latency connectivity needed to allow the utilization of virtual resources, they play a vital role in virtualization as well. Additionally, 5G networks can supply the bandwidth required for edge computing, which can lower latency and enhance the functionality of virtualized services. Because virtualization makes it possible to use resources effectively and provide services on demand, it is essential to cloud computing.

articleTitle: A Survey on Deep Learning based Computer-Aided Diagnosis Model for Skin Cancer Detection using Dermoscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In recent times, melanoma skin cancer is a commonly affecting disease over the globe. Visual analysis at the time of skin lesion examination is not an easier process, as there is a resemblance among lesions. Several imaging techniques have been available in the literature for skin lesion diagnosis and classification. Therefore, computer aided diagnosis (CAD) models are developed for assisting professionals in the diagnostic procedure. However, skin cancer diagnosis using dermoscopic images is highly challenging due to the limitations of artefacts, blurry boundary, poor contrast, and variable lesion shapes and sizes. Numerous research works have been carried out to resolve the challenging issues that exist in the skin lesion classification process. Recently, deep learning (DL) based CAD models have become more familiar in the skin lesion classification process. With this motivation, this paper reviews the existing practices, issues, and projections of image collection, pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and classification of skin lesion images. The survey aimed to report the statistical results from the recently presented models. Besides, the efficiency of different classification models is compared explicitly designed to detect skin lesion diagnosis and examined the equivalent outcomes. Furthermore, the existing methods are reviewed based on the major objective, methodology used, and experimental outcomes. At last, the limitations involved in some of the reviewed methods are pointed out and future improvements are suggested.

articleTitle: Efficient Model Training in Decentralized Systems with Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the fast-changing field of machine learning, data privacy and model training efficiency are crucial. Federated Learning (FL) is a breakthrough method for training models on several decentralized devices or servers without centralizing raw data. This study examines Federated Learning's challenges in optimizing model training in dispersed systems. The first stage is to examine the Federated Learning (FL) framework and its merits, particularly in protecting data privacy and reducing server dependence. The next section will discuss communication overhead, stragglers, and non-IID (independent and identically distributed) data issues in a decentralized training model. We developed novel optimization methodologies and adaptive algorithms to improve Federated Learning (FL) efficiency. This includes updating asynchronous models, adaptability-based communication frequency, and non-IID data management. We also present a resilient aggregation method that mitigates Byzantine failures in participating nodes. We demonstrate that our methods improve convergence rate, communication costs, and model performance trained with Federated Learning (FL) by conducting a series of comprehensive experiments and analyzing real-world case studies. We show that these enhancements do not compromise data privacy, preserving Federated Learning (FL) principles. In conclusion, this study advances Federated Learning in decentralized systems. In an age of data sensitivity, this approach could help implement efficient, scalable, and privacy-preserving machine-learning methods.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of IoT Malware from MQTT Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: As technology has improved, the usage of IoT devices has increased significantly in recent years. Due to their abundance, variety, and heterogeneity, IoT devices are vulnerable to cyber threats. IoT infrastructure faces serious security risks from a range of threats because it lacks a standard that supports all smart devices and an integrated security mechanism. The possibility for practically all internet attacks, including malware, viruses, and other threats, to be launched through IoT infrastructure can result in some losses. In the paper, different machine learning algorithms are proposed to detect and classify IoT malware from the MQTT dataset, a standard protocol for IoT messaging. The different machine learning algorithms such as Random Forest, CNN, Gradient Boost, Light GBM, and Naive Bayes are proposed and compared based on their accuracy, F1 score, and confusion matrix. Random Forest outperforms the other algorithms, provides better results, and effective in classifying the malware.

articleTitle: Investigating Blockchain Security Mechanisms for Tamper-Proof Data Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Across a wide range of sectors, blockchain technology has emerged as a game-changing option for secure data storage. This research dives into the mechanisms that enable blockchain to protect data integrity and immutability. This research investigates how blockchain technology reduces the chances of data tampering and unauthorized adjustments by examining its underlying concepts and features, such as decentralization, cryptography, consensus procedures, and immutability. Blockchain networks are decentralized, so they don't rely on any one entity to function. This eliminates one potential point of failure or manipulation. Data is protected from tampering and disclosure thanks to the use of hash functions and digital signatures, two examples of strong cryptographic algorithms. By confirming and agreeing on transactions, consensus methods like Proof of Work (PoW) and Proof of Stake (PoS) keep the blockchain ledger up-to-date and accurate. By linking blocks together and recording timestamps, blockchain makes it practically impossible to alter data after it has been recorded. The distributed ledger's availability to the public and ease of use encourage accountability and deter dishonest participants. Smart contracts eliminate the need for third parties by automating operations based on predetermined rules that cannot be altered after they have been created. This study also delves into blockchain fork resistance, incentives for truthful involvement, and other network security measures. It also covers the security implications of both permissioned and permissionless blockchains. Blockchain technology provides strong security procedures, but it has several drawbacks that must be taken into account. These include issues with scalability and the possibility of security flaws in smart contracts. Therefore, securing security and performance requires cautiously considering particular use case needs and picking the right blockchain platform and configuration. For blockchain networks to function properly in the real world, constant vigilance and updates are required

articleTitle: Advancing Deep Learning Models through Robust Feature Extraction and Transfer Learning for Enhanced Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Deep learning has changed image recognition forever, which has achieved amazing results in many areas. On the other hand, deep learning models depend a lot on the quality and amount of labeled training data. This study suggests a new way to improve deep learning models for image recognition tasks using transfer learning and strong feature extraction methods. First, we look into how well different feature extraction methods, like autoencoders and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), can distinguish features from pictures. Considering different network structures and pre-training methods, we look at how well they do in terms of accuracy and how quickly they can do their work. Next, we look at transfer learning as using models already trained on big datasets to make deep learning models better at generalization. We look into various transfer learning methods, such as fine-tuning, feature extraction, and domain adaptation, to make the already-trained models work for new picture recognition tasks. We also deal with the domain shift problem by suggesting ways to match the source and target domains' feature distributions. We look into methods like domain adaptation and antagonistic training to reduce the difference in distribution and make the learned features more transferable. We do a lot of tests on standard image recognition datasets like ImageNet and RobustFeatureNet to see how well the proposed method works. Our approach greatly enhances the performance of deep learning models compared to traditional training methods, as shown by the testing results. The suggested framework gets the highest level of accuracy while lowering the need for a large labeled dataset.

articleTitle: Gene Expression based Blood Cancer Classification Model using Natural Computing along with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: It is well established that utilizing gene expression data to classify cancer holds the solution to the basic issues with cancer diagnosis and treatment innovation. It's critical to create deep learning techniques that can accurately identify between various cancer subtypes or healthy and malignant samples. In this paper, gene expression-based Blood Cancer Classification (BCC) Model using Deep Learning with Genetic Algorithm (GA) is proposed. Here we used statically computed features and based on the statically calculated features to classify the cancer using Modified Deep Neural Network (MDNN) as a deep learning. Our developed work aims to offer a novel classification technique for gene expression human blood data that may be used to other high dimensional data issues and improve classification performance. The outcomes of the data trials demonstrate that the suggested BCC model performs well in comparison to lots of state-of-the-art works in terms of its effectiveness like as precision, recall (true positive rate), f-measure, and accuracy. Achieved average precision, average recall, average <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{f}$</tex>-measure, and average accuracy is 96.8%, 93.8%, 95.2% and 97.8% respectively.

articleTitle: Protecting Children's Data from Cybersecurity Attacks to Prevent Child Sexual Abuse: A Techno-Legal Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: The increasing technological advancements and interconnectedness in today's world have created a parallel digital realm for children to connect, learn, and communicate. However, this new digital environment exposes children to various cybersecurity threats, including misusing their data for purposes like child sexual abuse. This research paper addresses the pressing issue of safeguarding children's data from cybersecurity threats to prevent child sexual abuse in the digital age. The paper explores the vulnerabilities of various online platforms, the dual role of technology, and the prevalence of online sexual exploitation. The study comprehensively analyses the legal strategies needed to counter these threats while considering the technical aspects. It delves into international treaties, regional regulations, and national laws to protect children's online safety. It examines the legal framework across different countries, exemplifying age verification and content moderation strategies. The study emphasises the importance of parental education, digital literacy programs, and technology-based solutions for children's privacy. It highlights the roles of tech companies in ensuring safe online environments through content moderation, reporting mechanisms, and age-appropriate design. Finally, the paper seeks to contribute to the ongoing discourse on child safety in the digital era by providing insights and recommendations that enhance the protection of children's data within a legal framework.

articleTitle: Design of IOT Based Self Powered Smart WQMS using Filter Optimization with Efficient Sensor Node
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Growing population, industries, and global warming are degrading water quality, producing various diseases and health issues. The existing wireless sensor network (WSN) and internet of things (IOT) based systems to monitor water quality are not extensively explored and are deficient in filter optimization (FO) and efficient sensor node. In this research, a self-powered system (SPS) is proposed to monitor contamination of water in real-time. The proposed method comprises smart sensors array measuring potential of hydrogen (pH), electrical conductivity (EC), pressure, flow rate, water recovery ratio (WRR), and Total Dissolved Solid (TDS) before and after filtration through the membrane. The measured physical parameters are also collected and displayed through Arduino Pro Mini microcontroller at both ends. The data accumulated at both ends are transmitted to a master node and then to an open source cloud server named ADDA Fruit IO through ESP32 WSN modules for remote monitoring. Twelve highly saline random water samples are collected periodically to analyze the proposed system performance. The above physical parameters are analyzed using statistical methods such as multiple regression, analysis of variance (ANOVA), and correlation.

articleTitle: ChatGPT: A Comprehensive Review of a Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of Natural Language Processing (NLP), the emergence of large language models has redefined the boundaries of human-computer interaction. This paper presents an in-depth review of ChatGPT, a pioneering exemplar in this domain. We commence with a thorough discussion on the evolution of NLP techniques and models, culminating in the inception of ChatGPT. The critical examination of pertinent research papers, projects, and benchmarks showcases the progression of large language models in the context of complex language understanding and generation tasks. The primary focus of this paper is to elucidate the intricate methodology underpinning ChatGPT's architecture and technology. We meticulously outline the comprehensive training process encompassing pretraining and fine-tuning phases, shedding light on the nuanced decisions that bolster model performance. The dataset employed for training and validation is delineated, contributing to an informed understanding of the model's capabilities. The user experience and feedback section encapsulates the empirical perspectives of interacting with ChatGPT, elucidating its strengths and limitations. The paper also prognosticates on the challenges and future directions for ChatGPT. The extant limitations are outlined, and plausible avenues for research and development are suggested to propel the model's potential. In conclusion, this review synthesizes the contributions of ChatGPT in the NLP landscape, underscoring its significance in reshaping the frontiers of language-based human-computer interaction. By amalgamating insights from methodology, applications, ethics, and performance, this paper offers a comprehensive compendium of the evolution and impact of ChatGPT in the realm of NLP research and applications.

articleTitle: Optimizing Greenhouse Operations Through IoT-Integrated Environmental Control Systems: A New Era of Computer-Based Farming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Communication, Security and Artificial Intelligence (ICCSAI)
abstract: Technology is widely adopted across today's agricultural landscape to improve output, efficiency, and longevity. The Internet of Things (IoT) deployment inside greenhouse settings is one of the promising areas of technology integration. To maximize efficiency, this research investigates how the Internet of Things (IoT)-integrated Environmental Control Systems (ECS) might be used in greenhouses. Optimal growing conditions were maintained by constantly monitoring and adjusting factors like temperature, humidity, light intensity, and carbon dioxide levels using various Internet of Things (IoT) sensors and devices. Using a cloud-based data analytics platform, we analyzed massive data streams, discovered useful insights, and used those to inform our operational strategy development efforts. The study uncovered significant gains in agricultural productivity, less resource waste, and improved fore castability of crop development. In addition, the IoT-ECS's adaptability allowed for automated responses to unexpected environmental changes, protecting crops from destruction. This study demonstrates the promise of Internet of Things integration in greenhouses as a game-changing strategy for contemporary agriculture, ushering in a new era of precision farming that is good for the bottom line and the environment.

articleTitle: Intelligent Distributed Grid's Reactive Overcurrent, or over Prevention: Computer Intelligence in Power Grid
